content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171157223444.png
《GTA6》即将于11月19日在PS5和Xbox Series X|S平台发售，究竟该用哪台主机体验这款备受期待的开放世界大作？近日，知名网红“甲亢哥”iShowSpeed 在直播中也提出了这个问题，而《GTA6》预告片结尾的一句宣传标语，似乎很快就帮他做出了决定。
直播期间，甲亢哥向观众询问，自己应该选择哪台主机游玩《GTA6》。这时，坐在一旁的弟弟提醒他注意预告片开头的宣传信息“Plays best on PlayStation 5”（在 PS5 上体验最佳）。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171157038383.png
注意到之后，他立刻表示，自己百分之百会选择 PS5，并反问道：“《GTA6》都明明白白写着‘在 PS5 上体验最佳’了，那你为什么还要用 Xbox 玩？”

不过，这句宣传标语并不意味着 Xbox 版本无法获得良好的游戏体验。Rockstar 与索尼之间的合作由来已久，此次宣传也进一步凸显了 PS5 在《GTA6》营销中的重要地位。

content.v: 常年制作塞尔达相关内容的油管博主Zeltik证实，这款《时之笛》重制版将加入全新支线任务。在海拉鲁城堡镇，玩家初次见到药水店老板时，他正因为一只藏起来的虫子慌作一团，会递给林克一个空瓶子，请他帮忙捕捉。完成委托后，这个瓶子就归玩家所有，老板还会主动帮你装满一瓶回复用的红药水。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792200861_670310.jpg
当然，这算不上现代动作冒险游戏里那种多阶段的复杂支线，而且游戏里似乎也没有任务日志之类的功能可以追踪支线进度。但这至少说明，任天堂确实打算加入一些新内容，哪怕是对我们这些把《时之笛》通关了十几遍的老玩家来说，也能获得新鲜体验。
游戏中的打靶小游戏也推出了难度更高的新版本，玩家的射击时间被大幅压缩，说明各类小游戏也会新增挑战档位。Zeltik的视频还详细介绍了森林神殿布局上一些细微却颇有分量的调整，这意味着我们重温旧地牢时，也不会再是闭着眼都能走完的熟悉流程了。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: JY戴士（戴士）创办的狼人杀综艺《京城大师赛》近期因一场反作弊检查风波陷入争议，他本人赛后承认检查流程“唐突”并向当事选手道歉。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171137206863.png
10月16日，参赛选手汤米家维因发挥出色遭匿名举报作弊，被赛事方要求脱衣检查，最终未查出作弊设备。但汤米本人表示此举严重伤害了个人尊严与自尊。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261017_zy_red_164_2/1140.jpg
有法律观点指出，民间赛事无权对选手强制进行人身检查，即便选手提前签署协议，此类条款也因违反《民法典》而无效。
起初JY在直播中表示，未来计划让选手签协议，拒绝接受检查将视为自动解约，并认为技术反作弊手段效果有限。他随后承认检查决定“唐突”，明确表示工作人员、官方及举报人均应向汤米道歉，并承诺后续将出台更完善的制度，听取诉求给出最终结论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261017_zy_red_164_2/1313.jpg
该赛事是由JY戴士担任核心嘉宾的狼人杀推理社交游戏综艺，集合了众多职业玩家与人气主播，在抖音平台直播，场均在线稳定十万级。

content.v: 下一部《复仇者联盟》电影可能面临两项叙事压力：英雄阵容继续扩大，多元宇宙规则也日益复杂。ComicBook作者认为，新片既要让更多角色发挥实际作用，也要让未看完所有Disney+剧集的观众理解故事。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792207121_701978_jpg_r.jpg
首部《复仇者联盟》只需处理六名英雄，每个人都有明确的参战理由，角色之间也存在冲突。《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》的最终战虽然汇集大量人物，但观众此前已用十多年了解美国队长等核心角色，电影也为关键时刻留出了空间。
按作者统计， 漫威 电影宇宙中与复仇者联盟有关联的角色可能已有约15至20名，但Marvel并未公布正式成员名单。神奇四侠未来将加入漫威电影宇宙，X战警也可能进入相关叙事，多元宇宙还为旧角色或不同版本人物回归创造了条件。作者指出，若新片只把更多面孔放进同一场大战，部分人物难免沦为背景。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792207124_685519_jpg_r.jpg
规则衔接同样是一道难题。《洛基》涉及分支时间线，《蜘蛛侠：英雄无归》让三个彼得·帕克同场，《奇异博士2：疯狂多元宇宙》又引入宇宙碰撞风险。新电影需要解释这些概念，同时降低观众理解剧情的门槛。
作者以乔纳森·希克曼的漫画《秘密战争》为参考，认为宏大危机仍需围绕带有个人动机的核心矛盾展开，不能只依赖更大的团队、更强的反派和更高的世界存亡风险。这一观点属于评论性分析，并非Marvel Studios公布的剧情或阵容消息。

items.title: 《静穆急行列车909号房》Steam试玩版现已推出

content.v: 游戏开发工作室STUDIO909（总监：Kazuhide Oka）宣布，悬疑冒险游戏《静穆急行列车909号房》的试玩版现已在Steam平台推出。官方在线上游戏展示活动“The MIX Fall Showcase 2026”上宣布了试玩版上线的消息，同时公开了本作的预告片。
https://image.gcores.com/41a30a9dfa44243e312b4429def3e4ad-1920-1080.jpg
试玩版预计游玩时长约为30分钟。玩家可以通过多种方式尝试避免第七天发生的列车脱轨事故。此外，随着试玩版的推出，官方也开设了本作的Discord社区，将在其中发布游戏攻略及试玩版更新信息。
关于《静穆急行列车909号房》
https://image.gcores.com/5a25c414a580ad22d99b884ce2208005-1920-1080.png
听说过909号房吗——？
《静穆急行列车909号房》是一款铁道旅情冒险游戏。你将搭乘历时七日横跨大陆的「静穆急行列车」，踏上一段列车之旅。
为了寻找本应不存在的「909号房」，你将在列车中展开探索。客车、餐车、植物园……形形色色的车厢首尾相连，静穆急行列车正一路驶向大陆西岸。
旅途中，你会遇见形形色色的乘客，并略微了解到他们的人生经历。通过倾听乘客们的故事并完成委托，你将一点点地揭晓909号房的谜团。
https://image.gcores.com/d273243bb8ad528f5c544ccf2b8494bc-1920-1080.jpg
列车之谜与车厢重组
你将会在静穆号急行列车最末尾的车厢睁开眼睛，向车头所在的方向前进。
门对面会是怎样的车厢，都取决于此刻站在门前的你。客车、餐车、货车……游戏会从各式各样的车厢当中随机筛选出三项，并由你做出最终选择。通过探索车厢，偶尔还会发现可以让选项被重新筛选，又或者增加第四个选项的道具。
通过重组车厢，你有可能探索出从未被发现过的道路。被紧锁的门、按下去也没有反应的按钮、隐藏的棚顶隔间……许多谜团都正隐藏在「静穆号急行列车」的各个角落。
https://image.gcores.com/6e926b79eff4847e198417cc67a3e422-1920-1080.jpg
与各种乘客的相遇
每次停靠在车站，都会有形形色色的旅客乘上列车。
兽人、巨人、人造人……这是一个不同种族和谐共存的世界。纷争与偏见的漫长时代早已结束，每一个种族都享有着同等的权益，抹除差距与歧视的意识也正在影响越来越多的人。
即使如此，他们依然怀有着各自的烦恼。其中固然存在属于特定种族的困境，但也有的人正面对着已在心中积存已久的懊悔。像这样的烦恼，任何种族都无法避免。
人们都是为了什么而乘上静穆号列车？随着与乘客们的交流，解构他们的人生，你的存在说不定可以让他们的未来发生变化。而这一过程想必也会帮助你达成目的。
https://image.gcores.com/5c124b3a4fe3734200fd96a3a5eebcfc-1920-1080.png
不断循环的七天
静穆急行列车本应在第七天抵达终点站。
然而，就在抵达终点之前，列车遭遇了一场惨烈事故。车厢燃起熊熊大火，无人前来救援。所有乘客和列车工作人员都在事故中丧生。
然而，当你再次恢复意识时，却发现自己身处刚刚驶离始发站的静穆急行列车中。时间倒退了七天，列车再次向西行驶。但如果什么都不改变，七天后列车仍会再次遭遇事故。你必须在抵达终点站之前找到阻止事故的方法。
随着七天的旅程一次又一次地循环，你将逐渐接近这场时间循环背后的谜团。
https://image.gcores.com/81ace47a2a9770c404c833f68e0df98d-1920-1080.png
寻找本不该存在的909号房
你正在寻找静穆号急行列车上「本不应该存在的909号房」。车上没有这样的房间，下至乘客上至列车长都对其存在一无所知。
909号房究竟在哪？真的曾经存在过吗？——以及，你为什么要寻找那间909号房？除此之外……为什么每次死亡都会令时间倒转，反复经历相同的七天？你为什么可以主动选择门对面会出现怎样的车厢？所有疑问都还没有得到解决。
这一切的谜团，最终都将引领你抵达独一无二的结局。

content.v: 古老行业更会与时俱进，据媒体报道，最近AI短剧又火了一把，但近期短视频平台上，出现了一条AI小海的带货短视频，引发年轻网友集体反感。
视频镜头里，一个叫小海的小伙子脸色憔悴，对着镜头说自己父亲生病欠了债，没办法才出来卖点货还债，一口一个姨姨妈妈叫得格外亲热。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792207007_301520.png
更离谱的是，这并不是一个小海，网上一搜就会有几十个叫小海、小涛、小宇的账号，长得各不一样，故事却大同小异，全是清一色的卖惨带货。
据报道，这其实是批量复制的AI带货演员，专门收割我们妈妈、阿姨辈的长辈们，这又是一起AI带货的新套路。
有记者调查发现，在一些社交平台上，制作“小海”这类数字人的教程被明码标价，价格从几十元到几百元不等。
运营者批量生成“AI小海”后，输入卖惨、认亲的话术和文案，博取中老年人的同情，最终把流量引到商品橱窗。这些商品的价格往往高于其他电商平台的价格，卖得越多，获得的佣金抽成就越高。
有账号运营者表示，这套小海的模式和话术是公开的，人人都能用，选对中老年赛道，一天赚两三千算是少的。
事实上这些类似的套路也不新鲜，一年前，一批身着正装、言语温情的中年“AI王建国”，被精准推送给缺乏陪伴的中老年女性。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792207018_694238.png
而那是“AI小海”只是“AI王建国”身边的配角：“王建国的儿子小海”，曾向阿姨们倾诉自己因为没有妈妈而遭到校园霸凌，邀请阿姨们为父亲带来真正的幸福。
那时的“王建国”才是主角，而他要的幸福，是让姐姐们下单买货，好让他维持家庭生活以及儿子学业的开销。
随着国家大力整治AI技术滥用乱象，各大短视频平台陆续关停部分“王建国”账号、清空相关视频。
之后“王建国”的朋友、兄弟、领导，乃至女儿、儿子等配角，被运营者陆续推到台前，试图再造一个王建国式的流量入口。
其中儿子“小海”成了最火的一个，他接过父亲的剧本，也接过同一批姨姨妈妈，开始又一轮精心设计的收割。

content.v: RTX Spark版Surface Laptop Ultra在多项性能测试中落后于M5 Pro版14英寸MacBook Pro。两款受测设备分别售价5900美元和3700美元，前者贵出2200美元，但在本次测试涉及的多数工作流中未能取得更高性能。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792205622_484321_jpg_r.jpg
英伟达于6月公布RTX Spark“Superchip”后，披露华硕、戴尔、惠普、联想、微星和微软将推出采用该平台的笔记本。微软随后展示Surface Laptop Ultra，测试配置采用20核英伟达 Grace CPU、拥有6144个CUDA核心的GPU，并配备128GB LPDDR5X统一内存。作为对比的MacBook Pro搭载M5 Pro和64GB内存。
在Cinebench 2026、Cinebench 2024和Blender等CPU测试中，Surface Laptop Ultra持续落后于MacBook Pro，部分项目还不及搭载Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX的Legion Pro 5i，以及搭载Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 395的HP ZBook Ultra。

Photoshop、Lightroom和DaVinci Resolve Studio等创意工作负载呈现相近结果，Surface Laptop Ultra在Photoshop测试中位列末位。Premiere Pro与DaVinci Resolve的GPU项目里，其成绩也略低于M5 Pro。不过，Premiere Pro尚未针对RTX Spark完成优化，DaVinci Resolve则对苹果M系列芯片进行了较深优化。
在兼容Mac与Windows的GGUF大语言模型测试中，RTX Spark仅在Qwen 3.8 Q4项目超过M5 Pro。切换至负载更重的Q8模型后，M5 Pro重新领先，并在负载继续增加时保持优势。
RTX Spark仍较适合游戏场景，但现有测试显示，其游戏性能接近RTX 5060或RTX 5070笔记本GPU。后续应用优化可能缩小当前差距；就此次测试覆盖的工作流而言，Surface Laptop Ultra多出的2200美元尚未换来更高性能。

content.v: 《 暗黑破坏神4 》满是怀旧感的第15赛季埋入了大量系列历史彩蛋，不仅有完整任务复刻初代《 暗黑 破坏神》的主线流程，还有一整套护甲以《暗黑破坏神2》中首次登场、素来以隐秘难寻著称的奶牛关为主题。玩家很快就找齐了这套奶牛护甲的多数部件，唯独缺了名为“前胫护手”的手套，引得整个社区开启了长达数周的寻宝热潮，可直到此前都始终一无所获。事实证明，这款牛族前胫护手之前根本就没实装进游戏。要拿到这副手套，玩家需要抚摸一头特定的奶牛，而这头奶牛直到本周3.2.3补丁上线后才正式出现。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792200257_786313.jpg
据游戏站点Icy Veins报道，且经笔者亲自核实，最新版《暗黑4》在旧崔斯特姆的大教堂后方新增了一头可刷新的奶牛。玩家只需上前抚摸它，就能掉落牛族前胫护手，流程就是这么简单。数周以来，《暗黑4》玩家翻遍了第15赛季的所有内容，就为了找到这套奶牛护甲的缺失部件，结果暴雪就这么悄无声息地把它塞进了补丁里，补丁说明里连提都没提。这多少有点让人哭笑不得。

好在，《暗黑4》里孜孜不倦的刷装玩家终于能集齐整套护甲了，玩家Auscraft还制作了实用攻略，详细标注了每一件部件的具体获取位置。至于这套奶牛套的颜值，就得看你对角色幻化的偏好——有人觉得丑到离谱，也有人觉得酷感十足。我个人就非常喜欢。这套护甲造型搞怪夸张，除了用这种整活的方式，把护甲做得活像一头在旧崔斯特姆草地上吃草的活牛，我实在想不出暴雪还有什么别的方式，能向暗黑系列这段深入人心的经典内容致敬。美丑与否，就留给大家自己评判了。

content.v: 最近，R星发布了《GTA6》的发售宣传片，内容较多——军队背景故事、激情四射的淋浴性场景、杰森把一个人从船上扔下去、有人喊着“侠盗猎车手”。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792204728_296887.webp
然而在社交媒体上，不少玩家质疑《GTA6》的发售宣传片，让画面看起来比首支预告片“缩水了”，粉丝们认为粉丝宣传片的画面太糊，没有首支预告片那么明亮，充满细节。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792204706_882016.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792204706_492078.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792204706_328690.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792204706_536007.jpg
不过，分析认为，这种变化更可能来自较强的泛光（Bloom）与数字雾化处理，而非游戏画面缩水。
外媒详细报道：
在大型游戏发售前，粉丝们的眼光会敏锐到堪比实验室显微镜。任何多余的反光、颗粒或画面模糊，都可能被视为线索。哪怕只有几秒钟的模糊画面，也足以让人们在发售前一个月开始讨论游戏的画质是否缩水。
《GTA6》的新预告片就受到了这样的审视。该作将于11月19日登陆PS5和Xbox Series平台，而这段预告片是在发售前不久公布的。 许多观众注意到，视频画面明显比此前更柔和、更具“梦幻感”：高光区域向外晕染，对比度降低，色彩也仿佛褪去了一层。
有人反复检查了三遍，确认播放器确实设置为4K。但即便是Rockstar官方网站上未经油管压缩的版本，看起来也同样如此。
人们首先怀疑是技术原因： 有说法称，Rockstar为了让游戏在PS5上维持每秒30帧，降低了分辨率，因为白天场景包含更多细节。但这种说法经不起推敲，因为拥有数十乃至数百个光源的夜间场景，通常比白天场景更消耗硬件性能。 此外，在PS5上录制的加长版实机演示（Extended Look）画面更加清晰，也能稳定保持每秒30帧;而这支最新预告片本身，同样包含不少锐利清晰的镜头。
另一个解释似乎可信得多： 这并非单纯的画面模糊，而是强烈的泛光（Bloom）和雾化效果，相当于用数字方式模拟Black Pro-Mist一类柔光滤镜。
这种滤镜会让光线向阴影区域“溢出”，同时降低画面对比度。当画面中出现强光源时——例如日落、透过窗户射入的阳光或脱衣舞俱乐部的霓虹灯——这种效果会格外明显;没有强光源时，它便会消失 。一位以剪辑预告片为职业的人有95%的把握认为，这种处理是在模仿电影质感，也可能是在复刻20世纪70年代的美学，而《GTA：罪恶 都市 》最初正是从这种美学中汲取灵感的 。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792205074_271991_jpg_r.jpg
不过，这些担忧也并非毫无依据。《荒野大镖客：救赎2》的最终预告片同样充斥着泛光效果，而这种效果在正式游戏中也没有消失：夜晚的圣丹尼斯至今仍像笼罩在雾气中一样泛着光。在PS4版中，由游戏标志性TAA造成的模糊无法关闭，玩家只能手动调低HDR;到了PC版，去除胶片颗粒和模糊效果的模组，也成了最早流行起来的一批模组。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792205148_208814_jpg_r.jpg
加长版演示中也曾出现类似效果，就在露西亚驾驶一辆黑色汽车前去与劳尔见面的那场戏里。或许Rockstar只会在过场动画中采用这种调色，而不会将其应用于整款游戏。

items.title: 生软前制作人警告CDPR：你们危险了
items.summary: BioWare前制作人Mark Darrah近日公开表达了对CD Projekt Red（CDPR）开发路线的担忧

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171037371219.png
BioWare前制作人Mark Darrah近日公开表达了对CD Projekt Red（CDPR）开发路线的担忧。他警告称，CDPR正踏入高风险超大作区间。Darrah估算，CDPR当前推进的作品可能需要卖出1500万至2000万份才能实现盈利，这一门槛远高于多数3A游戏的商业预期。他曾担任《龙腾世纪：起源》联合总监，并参与《圣歌》的执行制作，对大型项目的成本结构并不陌生。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171037459945.png

在Darrah看来，行业对《GTA6》式超大规模项目的追逐正在挤压其他类型的生存空间。他提出，如果开发商减少对“下一款GTA”的执念，就能为销量达到300万至400万份即可成立的项目留出余地，并以《光与影：33号远征队》作为这类中等规模作品的代表。他本人也明确表示，不愿意参与那种必须卖出5000万份才能避免亏损的项目。换句话说，问题不在于CDPR有没有能力做超大游戏，而在于这种体量的游戏一旦未达预期，容错空间极小。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171037462976.png
目前CDPR正在同时推进《巫师4》《赛博朋克2》以及代号哈达尔计划的项目，其中哈达尔计划已从世界观构建阶段转入部分原型测试。需要说明的是，Darrah提出的成本与销量门槛属于其个人分析，并非CDPR公开的财务指引，也不代表上述任何项目已有成败结论。对CDPR而言，真正的考验或许不是能否做出更大的游戏，而是能否在规模与风险之间找到可持续的平衡。

截止发稿，该片在M站收录37家媒体打分，均分高达99分，并获得平台“必看认证”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171026499966.png
部分媒体评价
“《你能看到一切》不知为何，比宣传中所描述的更加令人震惊、更加曲折、更加棘手，也更加具有揭示性。这是一场令人瞠目结舌、彻底动摇认知的心理镜像迷宫，也是导演与拍摄对象之间一次令人兴奋、此生难得的碰撞。”
“《你能看到一切》几乎是你能想象到的最不像‘纯粹纪录片’的作品之一，而这恰恰是它的魅力所在。它宛如一场独一无二的心理剧马戏团，将真人秀与轻松随性的电影体验融为一体，但与此同时，影片也始终怀有真正探索真相的意图。”
90分｜《好莱坞报道者》
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171027121446.png
“影片最初呈现的是一幅极具亲密感的肖像，描绘了一名被妄想蒙蔽或蓄意行骗的人物。但随着故事展开，它逐渐显露出更加疯狂、更具野心、也更加难以预测的一面，最终让我们不得不思考：个人所认定的真相，究竟具有怎样的价值？”
《你能看到一切》由内森·菲尔德（Nathan Fielder）与兰斯·奥本海姆（Lance Oppenheim）联合执导，主角则是美国医疗科技公司Theranos创始人伊丽莎白·霍姆斯（Elizabeth Holmes），她也是曾轰动全球的“硅谷惊天骗局”的核心人物。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171028058502.png
影片记录了霍姆斯在入狱前34天邀请摄制组拍摄自己的生活。此后，剧组又历时三年追踪她与伴侣比利·埃文斯（Billy Evans）的日常生活。原本看似聚焦个人生活的人物纪录片，逐渐演变为一场关于真实、欺骗以及镜头伦理的深度探索。
霍姆斯曾被媒体称为“女版乔布斯”。她刻意模仿苹果创始人史蒂夫·乔布斯的形象，常年穿着标志性的黑色高领毛衣，推崇极简主义，并频繁登上主流科技与财经媒体的封面。她一度被视为医疗科技领域的颠覆者，创办的Theranos更曾被寄予厚望。然而，公司最终因其血液检测技术及相关商业宣传引发的欺诈问题而崩塌，霍姆斯也因此成为美国科技创业史上极具争议的人物之一。

items.summary: 投行花旗提出下一款《荒野大镖客》游戏的问世时间可能比外界预期更早

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171026043608.png
投行花旗近日在一份关于《GTA6》与Rockstar的报告中提出，如果Rockstar所称《GTA6》开发成本并未达到15亿美元，那么下一款《荒野大镖客》游戏的问世时间可能比外界预期更早，2027年或2028年发售“并非不合理”。不过，这仅是金融机构的预测，Rockstar与Take-Two均未发布任何产品公告。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171026133006.png

这一判断与Rockstar过往的作品间隔存在明显张力。2010年《荒野大镖客：救赎》、2013年《给他爱5》、2018年《荒野大镖客：救赎2》，再到2026年的《GTA6》，主要作品之间通常相隔数年，同系列续作的间隔更长。Rockstar曾尝试同时推进《GTA 6》与《荒野大镖客：救赎2》，但认为计划过于激进，最终将人力从前者调往后者。如今其开发模式已转为多个办公室集中完成一个项目，再转向下一个项目。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171026142389.png

支持“加快”说法的因素也存在。Take-Two CEO施特劳斯·泽尔尼克曾表示，不应把漫长的开发周期与对周期漫不经心的态度混为一谈，并称近期技术发展可能帮助旗下工作室在不牺牲质量的前提下缩短部分开发时间。Rockstar技术总监菲尔·胡克也提到，大规模招聘与技术栈更新应有助于未来提升开发速度。考虑到《荒野大镖客：救赎2》累计销量已达8700万份，推出续作确实是相对稳妥的长期方向。但在官方确认之前，2027或2028年仍只是花旗的推测。

content.v: 生成式AI正以多种形式渗透游戏行业，所到之处均引发激烈争议。打造了《星之卡比》《任天堂明星大乱斗》系列的传奇开发者樱井政博，近日就这项技术表达了担忧，并谈及了他眼中行业的薄弱环节。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792199784_207978.jpg
这番言论出自他接受日本游戏媒体Denfaminico Gamer的采访，相关内容随后经谷歌、DeepL等工具完成机器翻译。深耕游戏开发数十年后，他认为当前的问题十分复杂。首先他指出，原创作品的市场号召力已大不如前，不仅很难脱颖而出，更难吸引玩家买单。
因此，开发者更易倾向于沿用成熟的游戏类型与创意，而在他看来，AI的隐患正体现于此。AI技术只能基于已有内容生成，无法创造全新事物;但如果你的游戏采用的是屡见不鲜的玩法机制，就极易被生成式AI复刻出同类作品。
他以今年4月推出的《图书馆管理员》（Librarian）为例——这款游戏的核心玩法仅是整理旧图书馆。这类玩法简单的游戏最容易被AI复刻，因为其基础元素很容易被理解和改造。
这一问题正日益严峻。此前，开发者还能通过换素材、换皮跟风热门游戏赚快钱，而AI与随性编码技术更是让这种风气愈演愈烈。越来越多的工作室发现，自己最大的竞争对手是跟风蹭热度的厂商。
樱井政博的这一观察同时适用于独立工作室与大型厂商。而他认为唯一的慰藉是，这类跟风作品大多都会默默无名地销声匿迹。这也是开发者们在Steam平台常年面临的困境——每天都有数十款新作上线，想要突围走红难如登天。
目前没有简单的解决方案，只能保持警惕，将资金与注意力投向人工创作的游戏。说不定，下一个《星之卡比》就藏在这些作品中等待被发掘。

content.v: 模组玩家已将英伟达更新后的DLSS 5神经渲染模型导入《极限竞速：地平线6》和《生化危机：安魂曲》。两款游戏尚未获得官方支持，现有非官方测试中的性能增幅最高接近40%。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792203211_769261_jpg_r.jpg
这套模型最先随《NBA 2K27》的最新更新出现。英伟达表示，新模型体积缩小24%，4K分辨率下的显存占用降低20%，神经渲染处理速度最高可达此前的两倍；在画质相近的情况下，它可使《NBA 2K27》的帧率最高提升40%。
模组玩家随后通过实验版本的OptiScaler移植该模型。在搭载RTX 4060的测试系统中，《极限竞速：地平线6》的性能增幅接近40%，《生化危机：安魂曲》约为30%。另一组测试采用RTX 4080 SUPER，在4K分辨率并开启路径追踪后，帧率由108 FPS升至150 FPS，增幅约39%。
测试者同时发现，更换模型后画面饱和度有所降低，神经渲染效果也不再那么强烈。目前这些结果均来自非官方实验，实际兼容性取决于具体游戏、硬件及模组环境，不同配置未必能够复现相同增幅，也不能替代官方支持或完整的跨平台测试。

items.title: 索尼帧生成技术曝光！技术难度太大 给PS6用的？
items.summary: 近日，有玩家挖出索尼一项全新专利，索尼的这套机器学习帧外推技术，目标是实现附带极小额外延迟的帧生成方案。

content.v: 近日，有玩家挖出索尼一项全新专利，索尼的这套机器学习帧外推技术，目标是实现附带极小额外延迟的帧生成方案。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171011434093.png
该专利采用自编码器模型，读取历史画面、运动向量，同时结合玩家输入，在显卡渲染出新画面之前，提前预测生成下一帧画面。它的思路和现在大家熟悉的帧生成（FG）不一样：传统帧生成必须等下一帧渲染完毕，再在两帧之间插入画面，不可避免会带来延迟；而索尼这套方案是预判式生成，目标就是压低插帧带来的输入延迟。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171011518121.png
但这项技术落地难度非常大，现阶段PC平台都没有成熟可用的同类方案。需要注意，专利仅代表厂商的技术构想，不等于一定会在PS主机或者游戏中实装，最终能否落地仍是未知数。

content.v: Moon Studios在最新的“Wicked Inside”展示会上分享了动作RPG《恶意不息》1.0版本发布的新信息，介绍了全新的职业系统、阵营以及更多关于发布之路的细节。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792202953_754612_jpg_r.jpg
详情如下：
在最新一期的《Wicked Inside》节目中，Moon Studios公布了全新的职业系统详情，该系统有望大幅拓展玩家在圣岛（Isola Sacra）冒险中的战斗和角色选择。其他更新内容还包括玩家可以加入的新阵营，让玩家从全新视角体验圣岛，以及其他一些改进，进一步完善了动作角色扮演游戏（ARPG）的经典元素。
全新职业系统
以往限制玩家游戏风格的属性系统已被移除。现在，玩家只需拾取武器即可从24个职业中选择一个，并且可以将不同职业的特性转移给其他职业。例如，充能闪电的长矛如箭雨般倾泻而下，潜行战术能在战斗开始前就终结战斗，以及融合多个职业优势打造出令人瞠目结舌的协同武器系统。24个职业共计362种特性，这意味着特性槽位的填充方式多种多样，而武器的加入则进一步拓展了这些可能性。
阵营
在伊索拉萨克拉的六大阵营中，从一名新兵一路晋升至食物链顶端，例如断手刺客、圣礼卫队骑士或无言者。每个阵营都有其独特的任务线、全新特性、专属商人以及一些额外的惊喜。
塞瑞姆核心
职业系统决定了玩家的战斗方式，而塞瑞姆核心则决定了他们的生存能力，从生命值、耐力和专注力等简单的升级，到“野性”提升攻击速度或“深红”赋予生命偷取等更为奇特的属性，应有尽有。这是一个充满风险与回报的诱人游戏，因为核心数量超过上限意味着会受到更多来自所有攻击的伤害。
迈向1.0版本发布之路
这可不是一次小更新。《恶意不息》1.0版本更新将使游戏规模扩大近一倍，新增可探索区域、全新敌对阵营、全新首领、优化战利品系统、战斗系统升级、提升游戏体验，以及最重要的一点：确保PS5的性能尽可能流畅。

《恶意不息》是由Moon Studios开发的备受赞誉的动作角色扮演游戏，该工作室曾打造过广受欢迎的《奥日》（Ori）系列。这款游戏巧妙融合了黑暗的剧情、如画般的画面以及一流的类魂战斗和角色扮演游戏设计。玩家将扮演“塞里姆”（Cerim），一位拥有神秘力量的圣职人员，肩负着消灭瘟疫的重任。瘟疫是一种古老的瘟疫，已经开始吞噬圣岛（Isola Sacra），而这座岛屿本身就饱受政治动荡和死亡的摧残。玩家可以收集和制作武器、道具等，扭转战局，升级角色和家园，并在血腥与勇气交织的史诗故事中扮演自己的角色。
《恶意不息》目前在PC平台处于抢先体验阶段。该游戏将于2027年3月登陆PS5和PC（Steam平台） ，随后将登陆Xbox Series X/ S和Switch 2平台。

items.title: 职业选手被曝假赛后炫富翻车！晒大把现金被终身禁赛
items.summary: 近日，一名《反恐精英2》职业选手在因假赛被禁赛三年期间，于社交媒体晒出大笔现金并发表挑衅言论，结果遭到赛事诚信委员会（ESIC）…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171008309269.png
近日，一名《反恐精英2》职业选手在因假赛被禁赛三年期间，于社交媒体晒出大笔现金并发表挑衅言论，结果遭到赛事诚信委员会（ESIC）追加处罚，禁赛期限从三年升级为终身，相关行为还将被移交执法部门处理。
这名选手是年仅22岁的Palkovics Tamás游戏ID为“2xplayN”。10月15日，ESIC公布了针对NOMERCY战队五名选手的处罚结果。调查涉及该战队在Roman Imperium Cup VII期间的可疑比赛，以及一笔潜在奖金超过450万美元的投注。最初，playN被处以三年禁赛，禁止其参加ESIC及其成员组织旗下的赛事，禁赛期限持续至2029年4月。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171008372087.png
然而，处罚公布后不久，playN便在X平台发布了一张照片，展示自己手持数叠厚厚的现金。他还配文写道：“2029年，我们Roman Imperium Cup再见。”并附上了一个大笑表情。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171008386302.png
10月16日，也就是最初处罚公布的第二天，ESIC宣布将playN的禁赛处罚升级为终身禁赛。委员会表示，作出这一决定的原因是该选手随后发布了一系列公开内容，其中包括疑似现金的照片，以及涉及比赛操纵、下注奖金和未来复出的言论。ESIC认为，这些行为构成了“严重违规，造成了不当行为的表象”，违反了委员会的相关规定。
此外，ESIC透露，委员会计划将相关行为移交给Valve、政府机构及执法部门处理。
此次事件最初源于对NOMERCY战队的假赛调查。调查重点涉及该战队在2026年3月遭遇的四场失利。ESIC发现，这些比赛结果均符合一笔可疑组合投注的条件，而该笔投注的潜在回报超过450万美元。

content.v: 《排球少年！！》再次与日本春季高中排球赛事展开合作，作者古馆春一为此绘制了日向翔阳的新图，相关插画已由漫画官方X账号公开。这是双方自2020年以来首次合作，也是作品时隔七年再度联动该项赛事。

《排球少年！！》于2012年开始在《周刊少年Jump》连载，2020年完结，但动画目前尚未覆盖全部原作内容。电视动画第四季于2020年分两部分播出，电影《排球少年！！垃圾场决战》随后于2024年上映。
下一部电影《排球少年！！VS小巨人》已经正式确认，现阶段仅确定预计于2027年推出，具体上映日期、最终预告及流媒体安排均未公布。

原作在高中篇之后还描写了日向毕业多年后的职业排球故事，因此电影之后仍有可供改编的内容。不过截至目前，官方尚未确认电视动画第五季或另一部电影。

items.summary: 傅首尔主演的新片《爸爸咪呀》与草根动画《牛来》的票房对比登上微博热搜

content.v: 傅首尔主演的新片《爸爸咪呀》与草根动画《牛来》的票房对比登上微博热搜，一部是5000万投资、票房仅8.3万的“年度惨案”，另一部是制作粗糙、却靠“猎奇”逆袭至6400多万的票房黑马。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171006242906.png
《爸爸咪呀》于2026年8月21日上映，首日票房仅2600至3300元，观影人次116人。上映十天，全国累计票房8.3万元，片方分账不足3万元。影片排片极少，全国仅18场，场均不足7人。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171006503573.png
影片积压五年才上映，2021年杀青时正值傅首尔凭借《奇葩说》“人间清醒”人设热度巅峰期。但后续她在《再见爱人》中暴露真实婚姻状态，离婚后又因持续消费前夫引发舆论反转，导致投资方从2023年起一再推迟上映，最终2026年定档时热度已消耗殆尽。片中傅首尔饰演一位隐忍的贤妻良母，与她犀利强势的公众形象形成巨大反差，不少观众直言“看脸就无法入戏”。宣发几乎为零，排片又极少，影片迅速沉没。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610171006502959.png
相比之下，《牛来》首日票房仅3420元，前九天累计不过7000余元，眼看就要下映。但影片粗糙的画面和荒诞的剧情在社交媒体上引发猎奇式围观，单日票房暴涨，最终累计达到6400万元。

content.v: 《鹅鸭杀》(Goose Goose Duck)由Gaggle Studios开发，是一款支持5至16人同场对局的社交推理游戏：玩家随机化身鹅、鸭或中立阵营中的一员，为各自的胜利目标展开一场场悬念迭起的博弈。凭借诙谐的画风与高密度的玩家互动，游戏自上线以来持续走红——2023年初，其Steam版最高同时在线人数突破70万，其中超过七成玩家来自中国。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792202356_905287.png
2026年1月7日，《鹅鸭杀》手游正式开启全平台公测：全网预约用户突破2000万，上线24小时新增注册用户超过500万，登顶iOS免费榜;短短数日，新增玩家人数突破千万。随着庞大的玩家群体涌入移动端，《鹅鸭杀》的社交推理体验也进一步延伸至更多玩家的日常游戏场景，而“互动”作为贯穿游戏始终的核心体验，其重要性也愈发凸显。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792202356_679660.png
在推理与互动中，体验每一次未知
对于《鹅鸭杀》而言，玩家之间的实时交流并非简单的辅助功能，而是推动一局游戏不断展开的关键环节。在实时语音与文字的交流互动中，每一局都承载着紧张而充满变数的阵营推理体验：玩家既要完成任务、观察线索，也要在不断变化的身份关系与沟通交锋中辨别真伪;丰富的角色设定、随机的局势发展和高频的玩家互动，让《鹅鸭杀》的每一场对局都独一无二。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792202356_244296.png
图示：玩家通过发言、质疑与决斗等方式推进推理进程，实时互动让每局走向充满不确定性
守护社交空间，抵御黑产引流
但当游戏内的交流场景被黑产利用，原本服务于推理与社交的互动空间，也可能成为游戏外引流和违规招募的入口。部分违规账号利用QQ、微信及其变种发布游戏外联系方式，夹带黑产广告等内容，并通过拆分、谐音、符号替换，甚至、昵称组合聊天、标题组合正文等方式试图绕过检测。
这类内容不仅会干扰正常交流和对局氛围，还可能为玩家带来骚扰与风险。面对持续变化的黑产表达，单一的关键词拦截难以兼顾识别覆盖与正常玩家表达，而游戏内不同角色的特有表述及不同场景的玩法，也对内容治理的精细度提出了更高要求。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792202357_881068.png
图示：游戏内包含多类角色身份与专属表述，内容审核需结合角色语境理解
为进一步守护游戏内健康的社交环境，项目组与腾讯游戏安全ACE展开内容安全 合作 ，接入文本及图片检测能力，围绕聊天、资料及互动等核心社交链路，持续提升违规内容的识别与治理效率。
多场景协同治理，提升内容防护效率
针对游戏内多元的社交内容风险，ACE为《鹅鸭杀》提供文本及图片检测能力。在接入上线阶段，支持项目完成压测与验证，压测结果显示，检测请求成功率达到100%，检测结果一致性超过99.9%，这为能力稳定接入和后续运营治理提供了可靠基础。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792202357_512992.png
图示：昵称、聊天与互动留言共同构成核心社交内容，需按场景细粒度治理
在文本内容治理上，ACE有效地帮助游戏守护玩家聊天交流、账号资料及互动留言等核心社交场景的清朗：
l 对于大规模游戏来说，内容安全运营会更细致，每个场景需要有不同的策略，ACE支持按不同业务场景进行细粒度管控，并根据游戏特有审核标准调整检测策略;
l 针对游戏内特有表述、快捷发言等内容，ACE持续进行兼容与优化，在守护准确性的同时，尽量减少对正常玩家交流的干扰;
l 黑产治理是重中之重：
a. ACE支持上下文语义识别，可以提升对黑产变种表达和隐晦引流内容的发现能力;
b. 黑产常在游戏内发布“游戏外联系方式”，尤为需要关注，项目组开启ACE 相应标签能力后，对QQ、微信及其变种等常见引流表达实现了较好的识别覆盖;
c. ACE 的独家专利技术——团伙发言行为分析能力，可以对疑似黑产工作室的异常发言行为进行追踪，圈定黑产账号，为游戏侧风险研判和后续处置提供支持，协同提升对黑产团伙的打击效果。
在图片内容治理上，ACE为游戏内图片内容提供风险识别能力，与文本检测形成协同防护，帮助项目更全面地应对社交场景中的违规内容风险。
整个运营过程中，面对持续变化的违规样本，ACE结合实际运营反馈不断补充策略、优化识别效果，并且在版本更新、重大节日及重点运营时期提供专项护航，为游戏与黑产对抗的及时性与有效性提供了强有力的支持。
黑产干扰逐步收敛，社交环境持续改善
随着合作不断深入，游戏内针对游戏外联系方式、广告引流等违规内容的识别与处置效率持续提升。游戏发现黑产工作室的活跃度和干扰情况已有所收敛，游戏内的社交环境得到进一步改善。
内容安全治理需要持续应对不断变化的违规表达。后续，腾讯游戏安全ACE也将继续结合游戏运营需求，与项目组共同完善内容风险防控能力，守护每一位玩家安心发言、自由交流、专注推理的游戏体验。

本次展会现场开放两个试玩区域。
试玩区域：试玩区域提供 45 分钟试玩体验。游戏提供多种难度选项，玩家可自行调整，并选择地图探索或 Boss 挑战关卡进行体验。
Boss挑战区域：在限定时间内打过Boss的玩家，可以获得一份精美礼品。每日挑战速度前五的玩家，可以额外获得一份神秘大奖。
游戏简介
世界因遭到了异世界的突然入侵而变得支离破碎。作为这场灾难的幸存者格雯德琳，你将在现实与幻想交织的破碎伦敦中展开冒险，挑战来自异世界的敌人，揭开两个世界的秘密。
于湮灭边缘，拯救支离破碎的伦敦
来源未知的异世界突然入侵了伦敦。街道与地标不断扭曲、崩解，整座伦敦正被撕裂，并逐渐与异世界融为一体。 作为这一切的幸存者，你将直面异世界入侵，体验到丰富的关卡探索内容，揭示灾难降临的真相，并找到挽救家人、城市乃至整个世界的办法。
https://image.gcores.com/df2a7a1a3d8534349be9abcfd6d11d35-1280-720.png
收获骑士之力，构建自己的骑士团
旅途中，你将结识十余位出自亚瑟王传说的传奇骑士。他们拥有截然不同的战斗定位与能力，可承担突进、防御、爆发等不同职责。 你可以根据战斗需求或个人喜好对你的骑士团进行搭配，构建出丰富的战斗组合，不仅带来变化多端的动作连携，还将衍生出丰富的战术策略。 你将建立全新的战场态势，从此不再孤身作战。
https://image.gcores.com/bc9ba9ad72cdad3bfeda08aea4757e09-1280-720.png
与奇观般的巨像骑士在世界中相遇
高耸如山岳的巨像骑士游荡于世界之间。它们绝非仅供仰望的宏伟景致，而是静待有人踏足、探索并发起挑战的宏大舞台。你将与它们展开史诗般的战斗，也将攀登其庞大的身躯，深入隐藏于内部的宫殿，揭示每一位巨像骑士身负的故事。 它们将以前所未有的规模，为探索与战斗带来截然不同的体验。
https://image.gcores.com/3949b95411f045270ee68278b46248ca-1280-720.png
关于《湮灭之潮》
《湮灭之潮》是一款国产单机买断制骑士幻想动作冒险游戏，由日蚀边缘工作室研发和发行。游戏基于虚幻 5 引擎打造，仅登录 PC 及主机平台，游戏以「异世界入侵下的破碎伦敦」为核心设定，玩家将扮演灾难中的幸存者格雯德琳（Gwendolyn），在现实与幻境交织的伦敦废墟中展开冒险，对抗由异世界而来的威胁，并逐步揭开世界倾覆背后的秘密。
《湮灭之潮》现正面向 PC（Steam & Epic）、PlayStation 及 XBOX 平台开发中。
-官方网站 -Steam页面
关于日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）

日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）是一家面向全球玩家开发及发行 PC 和主机游戏的工作室，总部位于四川成都。工作室当前正在开发基于亚瑟王神话的动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，团队由 150 余名开发者组成，成员曾参与《如龙》（Yakuza）《荣耀战魂》（For Honor）《刺客信条》（Assassin's Creed）《女神异闻录》（Persona）与《波斯王子》（Prince of Persia）等知名游戏的研发。

content.v: 《恶意不息》此前推迟了原定于10月登陆PS5的计划，如今已确定将于2027年3月发售。需要说明的是，此次推出的将是1.0正式版。与目前已在其他平台上线的抢先体验版相比，预计会有大幅更新。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792201806_400248_jpg_r.jpg
1.0版本将加入职业系统、不同阵营各自的任务线，以及大量其他新增内容、重制内容和调整。正如新闻稿所说：“《恶意不息》的1.0更新将使游戏规模大致扩大一倍。”
你可以通过下方的开发者展示视频，看到其中许多内容的实际效果：
简单回顾一下，Moon Studios之所以推迟1.0版本，是因为团队不想仓促推出游戏——而且可能也不想撞上异常拥挤的游戏发售档期，尽管目前看来，2027年1月至3月也并不算特别清闲。
也就是说，等到3月到来时，一切应该都已准备就绪。希望团队能够实现这个已经筹备十余年的愿景。

content.v: 花旗推测，如果R星所称《GTA6》开发成本未达到15亿美元属实，下一款《荒野大镖客》可能比外界预想得更早问世，2027或2028年发售“并非不合理”。不过，这并非R星发布的产品公告，相关时间目前仍只是金融机构的预测。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792201259_798861_jpg_r.jpg
R星过往主要作品的推出时间存在较长间隔：
《荒野大镖客：救赎》于2010年推出
《给他爱5》于2013年推出
《荒野大镖客：救赎2》于2018年推出
《GTA6》于2026年推出
这一开发节奏也令2027或2028年的预测受到质疑。
R星曾尝试同步开发《GTA66》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》，但随后认为计划过于激进，将前者的人力转移至后者。目前，该公司通常由多个办公室共同推进一个项目，完成后再转向下一项目。《GTA6》发售后的支持及下一阶段线上体验也可能继续占用资源，不过R星尚未公布其线上运营计划。
另一方面，Take-Two与R星人员曾表示，新的组织结构、人员招聘和技术栈升级，有望在不牺牲品质的情况下缩短部分开发周期。《荒野大镖客：救赎2》累计销量已达8700万份，续作因此被视为相对稳妥的长期方向，但2027或2028年的具体时间仍未获得官方确认。
外媒GameSpot详细报道：
投资银行和金融服务公司花旗发布了一份关于《GTA6》和R星的报告，其中有一句话提到了R星接下来可能推出的作品——一款新的《荒野大镖客》游戏。
花旗在备忘录中表示，如果R星所称的《GTA6》制作成本实际上并未达到15亿美元，那么该工作室推出新一款《荒野大镖客》游戏的时间，或许会比人们想象得更早。
据雅虎财经报道，花旗认为，新一款《荒野大镖客》游戏在2027年或2028年发售，“可能并非不合理”。
不过，这只是花旗的判断。出于多方面原因，如果新一款《荒野大镖客》游戏最早明年就能发售，仍会令人感到极为震惊。
从以往情况看，R星的主要作品之间通常会相隔数年，同一系列不同作品之间的间隔甚至更长。例如，《荒野大镖客：救赎》于2010年推出，之后是2013年的《给他爱5》、2018年的《荒野大镖客：救赎2》，而《GTA6》则将于2026年推出。
另一个需要考虑的重要因素，是R星如今的游戏开发方式。该公司曾尝试同时开发《GTA6》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》。R星称，如果这种模式能够顺利实施，公司原本可以将《GTA6》的发售时间提前数年。然而，R星认为这一计划过于雄心勃勃，工作室负责人罗布·尼尔森最终决定将员工从《GTA6》项目调往《荒野大镖客：救赎2》，帮助后者顺利完成并推出。
R星曾一度由多个办公室同时开发多款游戏，但如今，R星旗下各团队会共同开发一个项目，完成后再转向下一个项目。
《GTA6》或许即将推出，但可以肯定的是，R星已经投入了大量资源，为游戏发售后的支持做准备，而这甚至还没有算上《GTA Online》的下一阶段发展。虽然R星尚未公布任何有关《GTA6》在线内容支持的计划，但外界普遍预计，《GTA6》将提供某种规模庞大的在线体验，并在未来多年持续获得支持。
与此同时，像R星这样的公司无疑已经开始规划未来，而推出一款新的《荒野大镖客》游戏，似乎是一个极为稳妥的选择。毕竟，《荒野大镖客：救赎2》的销量已经达到惊人的8700万份，使其跻身有史以来最畅销的游戏之列。
尽管花旗关于R星可能在2027年或2028年推出新一款《荒野大镖客》游戏的判断，或许过于雄心勃勃，甚至只是一厢情愿，但R星及其母公司T2都曾表示，公司已经建立了新的开发架构，以提高游戏制作速度。
Take-Two CEO施特劳斯·泽尔尼克告诉外媒The Game Business，人们不应“把漫长的开发周期与对开发周期漫不经心的态度混为一谈”。
有些游戏“开发起来极其复杂，也极具挑战性”，因此确实需要很长时间才能完成。不过，泽尔尼克表示，“近期的技术发展”或许能帮助T2旗下工作室“在不牺牲质量的前提下缩短部分开发时间”。
泽尔尼克所说的技术发展或许包括T2对人工智能的应用，但目前尚无定论。与此同时，R星的菲尔·胡克表示，公司大规模招聘并更新技术栈，应该有助于R星在未来提高游戏开发速度。
不过还需要注意的是，泽尔尼克和胡克关于加快游戏制作速度的说法，或许主要是说给分析师和投资者听的。《GTA6》推出后，R星是否真的还需要再过八年才能发布下一款游戏，只有时间能够证明。就目前而言，这些仍然只是说法。

content.v: 当下，AI将给各行各业带来多大颠覆，似乎所有人要么对此兴奋不已，要么忧心忡忡。在这种背景下，听到有人基本上抱持“也就那样”的态度，反倒让人耳目一新。而这似乎正是科乐美社长早川英树在公司最新财报中传达的观点。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792199172_329552.jpg

这份由日本媒体《电击》发掘、经Automaton翻译的财报，详述了科乐美当下面对AI快速普及的应对策略，以及其对该技术给整个游戏行业带来潜在影响的看法。目前业内的普遍共识像天气一样反复无常：一方面，AI作为大幅提升生产效率的工具，普及几乎已是必然;但另一方面，AI生成的美术、配音等实际游戏内容越来越多，更不用说AI辅助的随性编码热潮让微软洋洋自得，这都让业内不禁思考，是否该为此划定界限。而在早川英树和科乐美看来，或许根本没有划界的必要。
根据Automaton的译稿，早川英树在科乐美财报中称，AI大概率不会给游戏市场带来“显著变化”。针对AI可能降低游戏开发者入行门槛的提问，他也持否定态度。
“通用游戏引擎的技术进步和用户生成内容（UGC）的普及，早已拉低了入行门槛。”他补充道，“即便AI的应用确实能提升生产效率，我始终相信，打造有趣且富有创新性的电子游戏，最重要的核心要素永远是人、是创作者。”

content.v: GameSpot发布《使命召唤23：现代战争4》战役评测，给出7分（Good）。评测认为，本作没有追求创新，而是回到更传统、更线性的战役结构，依靠扎实的叙事、紧凑的节奏和多样化的任务设计，交出了一份令人满意的收官答卷，也是自2019年《现代战争》重启以来最好的战役。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170939207558.png
评测肯定了任务多样性：潜行、徒步与载具追逐、慢动作破门、直升机炮手、夜视清房等经典桥段均有出现，且整体节奏没有因多线叙事和多视角切换而松散。可选对话提示得到保留，Boss式近战遭遇虽然不复杂，但为流程增加了张力。唯一的开放世界任务允许玩家直接快速旅行到目标点，跳过探索和收集，评测认为这反而让该设计的存在价值受到质疑，不过也为愿意探索的玩家提供了重玩空间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170939331182.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170939346549.png
缺点方面，评测指出最终“Boss战”令人失望，缺乏挑战且过于短促，但故事收尾仍算令人满意。整体而言，GameSpot认为《现代战争4》证明系列不需要彻底重造轮子，只要叙事扎实、角色可信、任务保持紧迫感，就能做出令人投入的单人体验。

items.title: IGN 8分！《使命召唤23》战役：重启后最好的一部
items.summary: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》战役评测

content.v: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》是 Infinity Ward 打造的系列重启续作，本次评测聚焦单人战役。战役约 7 小时、共 16 个任务，融合传统军事关卡、潜行渗透、开放区域探索与大规模战场演出，并首次将 DMZ 模式理念引入战役。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170923104845.png
简评：
《现代战争4》战役是系列自 2019 年重启以来最出色的一次。它果断甩掉前作叙事包袱，以扎实的任务设计、多样玩法和真正有情感分量的新角色，重新找回《使命召唤》应有的样子。开放区域任务堪称亮点，大规模战场演出依旧震撼，枪械手感与音效维持顶尖。潜行和近战偶有瑕疵，也缺少一个历史级关卡，但整体节奏紧凑、执行稳定。若这是系列收官，至少是在高光中告别。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170920475112.png
IGN评分： 8
总评：
战役最大的成功是结构清晰、节奏稳定。双线并行，一条偏谍战动作，一条偏小队战争，最终自然交汇。新角色成为情感锚点，让故事有了久违的羁绊；旧角色和旧线索则被果断收束，整体收尾利落。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170923039680.png
任务设计多样，传统军事关卡与敌后求生交替出现。开放区域任务引入 DMZ 思路，允许自由选择目标、搜集装备、制作道具，是整场战役最亮眼的部分。大规模战场演出依旧震撼，枪械手感、移动和音效维持顶尖水准。潜行与近战系统偶有挫败感，也缺少一个足以封神的关卡。
整体而言，这是 2019 年重启以来最佳《现代战争》战役，执行稳定、诚意充足。它未必能跻身系列最顶尖行列，但如果这是该传奇的终点，至少是一次体面的高光退场。

items.title: 数毛社分析《GTA6》新预告：原生2K升频至4K 30帧
items.summary: Digital Foundry对《GTA 6》发售预告片的技术分析

content.v: 据Digital Foundry对《GTA 6》发售预告片的技术分析，本作在基础版PS5上的运行规格已基本明朗：1440p原生渲染，空间升频至4K输出，帧率锁定30 FPS。分析指出，Rockstar在基础版PS5上实现了“可能是我们见过的最令人印象深刻的实时渲染演示”。
视频欣赏：
分析确认，预告片中的光线追踪被大量用于全局光照和反射，但Rockstar也混合使用了传统技术——部分阴影依赖传统阴影贴图，反射则结合了屏幕空间反射与立方体贴图，以平衡画质与性能。Digital Foundry明确表示，未发现QSSR（快速光谱超分辨率）的使用迹象，画面仍是相对简单的空间升频，这导致了一些画面模糊和边缘闪烁。这意味着基础版PS5用户暂时无法通过索尼的AI升频技术获得画质提升。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170859428316.png
另一个值得关注的发现是，RAGE引擎长期存在的动画节奏问题似乎已得到修复。这一问题自《GTA4》以来便困扰着Rockstar的作品——即便帧率稳定，相机移动和角色动画仍会出现微小抖动。在发售预告片中，Digital Foundry未能在慢速镜头旋转中检测到此类卡顿。不过分析也谨慎指出，Rockstar可能只是选取了问题不易显现的片段，最终结论仍需等游戏发售后的完整测试。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170859533071.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170859544531.png
至于60帧模式，Digital Foundry对此持悲观态度。PS5 Pro的CPU与基础版PS5几乎相同，在CPU受限场景下性能提升仅约7%，不足以支撑60帧运行。Rockstar North联合负责人Rob Nelson此前已确认游戏以30帧为目标，并表示是否推出60帧模式“需要咨询技术团队”。

content.v: 《GTA6》可能在首发阶段打破系列收入纪录。第三方预测认为，本作发售时的预购量或达2500万份，对应收入约20亿美元，超过《给他爱5》发售三天取得的10亿美元。
《GTA6》定于11月19日登陆PS5和Xbox Series X|S，基础版售价80美元。Sensor Tower追踪数据估计，截至10月13日，本作预购量约608万份，收入约5.94亿美元，其中PS5占74%，Xbox Series X|S占26%。该机构的Karl Kontus预计，预购量在发售时可能增至2500万份，但这一数字仅为第三方预测。
Take-Two尚未公布实际预购数据。负责人Strauss Zelnick仅表示，预购表现大幅超过国际市场预期，同时强调预购订单仍可取消，直接披露原始数字可能误导投资者。
作为参照，《侠盗猎车手5》发售24小时收入达到8亿美元，三天达到10亿美元，目前累计销量已超过2.3亿份。《荒野大镖客：救赎2》首个周末收入为7.25亿美元，累计销量超过8700万份；《辐射4》首发日出货1200万份，销售额超过7.5亿美元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261017/1792197333_190972_jpg_r.jpg
GameSpot报道：
经过多年的开发，以及或许比任何其他游戏都更受瞩目的宣传，GTA6将于11月19日登陆PS5和Xbox Series X|S平台。预测它将在商业上取得巨大成功，或许是任何人都能做出的最稳妥的预测之一。
但这款游戏的发布规模究竟会有多大?如果GTA6真的达到了预期，它又能打破哪些纪录呢?
记录
上一款GTA游戏，即2013年的给他爱5，一经推出便大获成功。它在发售后的24小时内就斩获了8亿美元的收入，三天内更是突破了10亿美元大关。即使十年过去了，这款游戏依然是销售巨头，销量已超过2.3亿份，而且还在持续增长。
Rockstar最新游戏《荒野大镖客2》（2018年发行）首周末收入高达7.25亿美元，累计销量超过8700万份，跻身史上最畅销游戏前五名。
除了Rockstar之外，Bethesda于2015年推出的角色扮演游戏《辐射4》也取得了巨大的成功，仅在发售当天就售出了1200万份，销售额超过7.5亿美元。
总而言之，GTA6预计将打破以下记录：
给他爱5：24小时内收入8亿美元，三天内收入10亿美元
《荒野大镖客2》：首周末票房7.25亿美元
《辐射4》：首发当日收入7.5亿美元
GTA6面临着巨大的挑战，它需要达到甚至超越Rockstar之前的游戏和《辐射4》。但如果Sensor Tower预测的发售时预购量达到2500万份的数据是正确的——或者接近这个数字——那么它应该能够轻松超越给他爱5的首发销量。
与之前的游戏相比，GTA6的一个优势在于其更高的售价。GTA6的基础游戏售价为80美元，而几年前给他爱5和荒野大镖客2的首发价格均为60美元。
当然，考虑到通货膨胀，2013年的60美元相当于今天的85美元左右。但即使经过通胀调整，如果《GTA6》真的像大家预期的那样大获成功，其首发销量也可能更高。而且可以肯定的是，当Take-Two最终公布《GTA6》的销售数据时，他们会不惜一切代价，用尽一切手段，以最完美的方式呈现数据。
目前为止的数据
自6月预购开启以来，Rockstar及其母公司Take-Two官方从未公布过任何预购数量或销售预测数据。Take-Two总裁施特劳斯·泽尔尼克表示，公布预购数据并不明智，因为这些数据可能会产生误导。他的理由是，严格来说，《GTA6》目前尚未售出任何一份，因为理论上，所有预购的游戏都可以退货。当然，这种说法很荒谬;泽尔尼克似乎只是在坚持他一贯的作风——从不在成功之前就宣布成功。
无论如何，泽尔尼克表示，《GTA6》的预购量“远远”超过了国际预期，但他没有说明这些预期是什么，也没有说明这些预期“是否意味着什么”。
Zelnick表示，分享GTA6预购的真实原始数据可能会误导投资者，因此Take-Two不会这样做。
泽尔尼克说：“我提醒过大家，我们根本不知道需求曲线会如何变化，因为这种情况以前从未发生过。鉴于此，我们认为原始数据可能会产生误导，而这种误导的方向让我们感到担忧。”
在Take-Two最近一次财报电话会议上，泽尔尼克谈到《GTA6》的预购数量时说：“Take-Two乃至整个行业都从未见过这样的情况。”他补充道：“需要说明的是，我们目前还没有售出任何一份。您可以取消预购。”
发售首周预算达到20亿美元?
市场研究公司Sensor Tower推出了一个名为“GTA6销量追踪器”的网站，该网站显示了GTA6的预购量估算，截至10月13日，预购量已达608万份，而且显然包含了所有退货/退款的订单。该机构估计，迄今为止，GTA6的收入已达5.94亿美元，其中PS5的份额占74%，Xbox Series X|S的份额占26%。
Sensor Tower的Karl Kontus在一次采访中表示，GTA6发售时的预购量可能在2500万份左右，这将是“前所未有的预购成绩”。

他表示，如果预购量达到2500万份，总收入将达到约20亿美元，足以支付游戏的开发预算和大部分营销费用。Kontus还表示，他预计《GTA6》的大部分预购订单将集中在发售前最后一周左右，届时游戏的热度将达到顶峰。Sensor Tower指出，目前预购订单中100美元版本的占比略高，但这也在情理之中，因为早期预购的玩家很可能是游戏的忠实粉丝。Sensor Tower预计，游戏发售时，80美元版本和100美元版本的预购订单数量将大致持平。
发售仅仅是开始
GTA6目前被宣传为主机独占的单人游戏体验。虽然现在看来确实如此，但大家都期待Rockstar会为GTA6推出下一代GTA Online模式，并最终将其移植到PC平台。最近的一份报告称，PC版的发布时间可能会比预期更早。
杰富瑞投资公司近期发布的一份报告指出，截至10月16日，Take-Two的股票目前交易价格约为每股200美元，处于折价交易状态，并有望上涨至每股300美元。该公司看好Take-Two，不仅因为《GTA6》预计将大获成功，还因为下一代《GTA Online》将成为新的收入来源，而即将推出的PC版也将开启新一轮销售周期。

这些并非异想天开。毕竟，时至今日，《GTA Online》依然通过各种微交易和GTA+订阅服务为Take-Two带来稳定的收入。因此，我们有理由相信，Rockstar会在《GTA6》中进一步完善《GTA Online》，并创造更多方式让玩家在游戏世界中消磨时间（和金钱）。至于PC版，如果玩家更喜欢PC平台，那么《GTA Online》自然会促使他们选择PC版，而玩家也可能因此成为“双重受益者”，从而进一步增加Take-Two的收入。
不同的主机市场
给他爱5发售时正值PS3和Xbox360主机生命周期的末期，这无疑创造了一种独特的市场环境，极大地提升了游戏的销量潜力。这两款主机的总装机量超过1.5亿台，这意味着Rockstar拥有一个庞大的市场。正如上文所述，在这样的环境下，给他爱5的销量非常出色。
R星最初在这些平台上发布了这款游戏，随后又陆续将其移植到PS4和Xbox One，并在之后的几年里陆续登陆PS5和Xbox Series X|S，期间不断进行改进。虽然在某些情况下可以免费升级，玩家无需再次付费，但可以肯定的是，很多玩家都重复购买了游戏。
GTA6的发售正值主机市场与以往截然不同之际。由于关税、人工智能驱动的内存和组件需求、伊朗战争以及其他各种全球宏观经济因素推高了价格，PS5和Xbox Series X|S如今的价格比以往任何时候都高。PS5的销量已超过9500万台，据估计Xbox Series X|S的销量约为其三分之一，因此两款主机的总销量可能超过1.2亿台。
从长远来看呢?
如果《GTA6》在发售初期销量超过《给他爱5》，这并不意味着它最终就能赶上《给他爱5》。《给他爱5》的销量已超过2.3亿份，这得益于上文提到的独特模式。此外，这款游戏发售时，市场尚未出现如今这种“服务型游戏黑洞”，例如《堡垒之夜》和《Roblox》等游戏正在蚕食玩家的时间和金钱。
虽然PS6和Xbox的Project Helix系列主机一直备受关注，但有报道称，由于上述复杂且棘手的问题，这些平台可能会延期发布。不过，无论下一代PlayStation和Xbox主机何时上市，我们几乎可以肯定GTA6最终都会移植到这些平台上。
至于Switch2这个庞大的市场，GTA6目前尚未宣布登陆任天堂平台。不过，也不能完全排除这种可能性，因为据报道Rockstar曾进行过相关测试——但这可能也只是测试而已。任天堂美国总裁建议玩家向Rockstar询问Switch2版GTA6的相关信息。
GTA6面临的另一个问题是，由于上文所述的市场因素，主机世代更迭的周期比以往要长得多。因此，尽管Rockstar能够每隔几年就将给他爱5移植到新平台并从中获利，但未来这可能会更具挑战性。
尽管可能存在这些不利因素，但我相信GTAOnline的下一代产品将会成为一款真正的巨头，最终超越主游戏。首先，我预计Rockstar会大力发展用户生成内容，并为GTAOnline打造一个更大、更丰富的世界，让玩家有更多事情可做，更有理由继续玩下去。反过来，这也能为Rockstar创造更多盈利机会，并打造属于自己的元宇宙。希望Rockstar能尽快公布GTAOnline2.0的最新消息。
GTA6对很多人来说都是一款必备游戏，但对于那些还在犹豫不决、还没有游戏机或者想要一台新游戏机的人来说，花600美元买一台PS5基本款或者花500美元买一台Series S可能会让他们大吃一惊。

items.title: IGN 9分《黎明行者》重磅更新1100项改进 新难度
items.summary: 《黎明行者之血》开发商Rebel Wolves正式宣布，游戏首个大型发售后续更新 1.1版本将于下周推送

content.v: 《黎明行者之血》开发商Rebel Wolves正式宣布，游戏首个大型发售后续更新 1.1版本将于下周推送，包含超过1100项改进与修复。这款由前《巫师3》核心开发者打造的吸血鬼RPG于今年8月发售，销量在两天内突破100万份，媒体均分在83至86分之间。1.1更新将带来三项玩家呼声最高的核心功能。
终于可以撸狗撸猫了。 游戏此前没有任何动物互动功能，而1.1版本将把本作独特的定向战斗系统延伸到动物互动上。Rebel Wolves官方在X上写道：“当定向战斗系统与撸猫撸狗的能力融合，会得到什么？定向。动物。撸。”玩家将可以用与攻击、格挡相同的方向输入系统来抚摸游戏中的猫狗。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170849064836.png
心灵重生药剂：免费洗点。 新增消耗品“心灵重生药剂”（Draught of Mind Rebirth），饮下后可清空所有剑术、巫术与吸血鬼能力的升级点数，重新分配以尝试全新流派。此前游戏完全没有洗点选项，在时间机制导致资源紧张的情况下尤为严苛，PC玩家只能依赖非官方Mod，如今官方终于给出了解决方案。
难度体系全面重构。 原“故事”模式更名为 “宽恕”（Forgiving） ，而“故事”这一名称将被赋予一个全新的、更简单的模式，提供额外的战斗辅助功能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170849182684.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/17/small_202610170849192136.png
此外，1.1更新还将改进帧生成技术、战斗中的镜头动画与锁定系统、暗影步与位面移动的操控响应，并为日本版Steam解除血腥内容审查。字幕系统也获得增强，支持放大字号及全部对话显示。

items.summary: 作为 WEG 的第一款作品，又是业界少见的生存恐怖类银河城游戏，《银松镇》或许可以算是独立恐怖游戏领域今年最大的惊喜之一。

content.v: https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/headpic/2026/10/head-9658sq-banner.jpg

《银松镇》 （Silver Pines）是一款由 Wych Elm Games（下称 WEG）开发、Team17 发行的生存恐怖类银河城游戏，在 2025 年 10 月 23 日正式公布，并于今年 10 月 8 日登陆 PS5、XS，NS、NS2 及 Steam 平台。游戏故事发生在一座几乎已被废弃的美国小镇——银松镇，主角雷德·沃克（Red Walker）受人之托，来此寻找音乐人艾迪·韦尔维特（Eddie Velvet）的下落。随着调查深入，雷德逐渐揭开了小镇黑暗的过往，而他也发现自己的工作似乎并不是简单的寻人。

虽然 WEG 的 5 名成员分别居住在瑞典和挪威等地，导致开发全程采用远程办公模式，但明确的分工、顺畅的沟通以及全员都拥有在 3A 游戏开发关键职位上积累的丰富经验，使工作室首作《银松镇》的制作过程十分顺利，成品也拥有不俗的质量。WEG 联合创始人里努斯·拉尔森（Linus Larsson）与马蒂亚斯·斯尼格（Mattias Snygg）曾在以《绝地潜兵》（Helldivers）系列闻名于业界的 Arrowhead Studios 任职，作为开发的领路人，拉尔森负责本作的关卡设计，斯尼格专注于美术和动画，剧本则由两人共同负责。
在现如今独立恐怖游戏大行其道的年代，玩家似乎总能在其中任意一部作品里嗅到《生化危机》（Resident Evil）或《寂静岭》（Slient Hill）系列的味道，WEG 也毫不避讳地提到了对两者的致敬与参考。“生存资源有限”“受限制的道具格子”以及“通过解谜和战斗推进剧情”这三大经典设定完美融合在《银松镇》的银河城地图中，玩家不仅要抽丝剥茧般揭开小镇神秘的面纱，还要应对小镇中游荡的魑魅魍魉。

在构思本作剧情时，对已故知名导演大卫·林奇（David Lynch）的作品情有独钟的拉尔森和斯尼格几乎同时想到了 1990 年的经典惊悚美剧《双峰》（Twin Peaks）。该剧集表面是在调查小镇谋杀案，实则深入探索梦境与现实、善恶与人性的深渊，充满了隐喻、黑色幽默和诡异要素。同样来自于 90 年代的《异世浮生》（Jacob's Ladder）、《8 毫米》（8mm）和《X 档案》（The X-Files）等经典作品也是《银松镇》的灵感来源，以上作品的剧情发展有一个共通点：主角在调查过程中似乎不断在现实与梦境间徘徊，导致两者的边界越来越模糊，而对真相挖掘得越深，真相对主角的反噬也越大。
游戏中，雷德会遇见不少看似还活着的居民，他们似乎早就认识这名自以为是来寻人的侦探，不过，当小镇的秘密不断被揭开，这些善恶难辨的 NPC 会逐渐消失。而每离真相更近一步，雷德就会出现剧烈的头痛，过往也会同步闪回。到最后，玩家可能会怀疑，这次寻人是否只是雷德做的一场噩梦，亦或是雷德根本不存在，他只是游戏中某名角色在梦中虚构的自己？
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-19350xd.jpg

为了给玩家带来较真实的体验，WEG 采用了“转描技术”（rotoscoping）来绘制游戏中的角色，该技术由麦克斯・弗莱舍（Max Fleischer）于 1914 年发明，操作者需使用转描机将胶片画面投射在毛玻璃上供画师拓绘。WEG 的制作方法则是先拍摄工作室成员的静态照片，之后由美术总监斯尼格用数字软件一帧一帧对照画面描轮廓，再上色做成 2D 精灵图。拉尔森曾在采访中表示，选择这种技术是为了赋予角色逼真的外观，尤其是在衣物和头发的动态表现上。

游戏舞台银松镇则使用了重绘摄影纹理的实地拍摄照片来制作，开发团队将主角、NPC 和敌人的 2D 精灵图置于由这些照片搭建出的模拟 3D 环境中，从而营造出 2.5D 般的景深感。在设计移动机制时，开发团队遵循了“玩家应能向环境中的可见目标移动”这一理念，旨在让城镇呈现出真实可信的空间感。如此一来，玩家能切实感受到，主角沃克是在山脚下的郊外探索完毕后乘坐渡轮来到闹市区，之后又乘坐缆车来到西亚·科帕山。各个建筑物内的探索过程也十分有立体感，这与很多银河城游戏只有两个维度的地图形成了鲜明对比。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-29385yx.jpg

到达银松镇时，雷德可以说是一穷二白，没有武器，身上能携带道具的空间也不大，且肺活量极为有限，导致无法在水中停留太长时间。随着游戏推进，玩家不仅能搜刮到各种类型的枪械，还可以找到具备不同功效的近战武器：小刀攻击距离短，但能划开挡路的白布；撬棍对龟裂的水泥墙毫无办法，却可以敲碎木板；在找到大锤后，玩家基本就在小镇里畅通无阻了。除了可以跳过鸿沟，雷德还能高跳爬上平台边缘，在边缘处按方向键下则会悬挂在边缘上减少下落高度差防止摔伤，这一灵感来自于 1989 年出品的初代《波斯王子》（Prince of Persia）。此外，蹲下移动可以进入较低的通道从而发现隐藏房间，战斗中蹲伏能够躲避敌人的远程攻击，遇到未被惊动的敌人则可以蹲下悄悄通过，避免与其正面冲突。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-39416sn.jpg
作为一款银河城游戏，地图中自然有不少收集要素供玩家掘地三尺。雷德在隐藏的角落能找到不少功效各异的纪念品，装备后可以获得增益效果，比如“换弹速度增加 30%”，还有提升跑步速度和肺活量的特殊纪念品。若集齐全部 25 种纪念品可以解锁一个秘密结局，该结局似乎揭示了主角的身世之谜。
雷德最多能同时装备 5 个纪念品，但初始时只有 1 个纪念品插槽，寻找并把纪念品容器碎片拼接成完整的一块方能扩展插槽。如果发现道具栏容量捉襟见肘，玩家就需要找到背包从而扩充大衣口袋了。后期面对强大的敌人和频繁的战斗，动不动就体力不支的主角最好能够找到咖啡机喝咖啡以增加体力上限，这一设定来自于上文提到的《双峰》。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-49461MK.jpg
鉴于构架是真实世界，银松镇的流通货币是美元，搜刮到的金钱可用在安全屋的自动贩卖机中购买弹药、道具和补给。存档则是在公用电话亭投入硬币拨打雇主的电话汇报调查进度，而每个电话亭下面的退币口还贴心地留有 1 美元，让玩家不至于陷入没钱向雇主汇报的窘迫境地。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-59476Lo.jpg
相比于晦涩难懂的全员谜语人剧情，游戏的谜题可以说平易近人，大多可在周围环境或文档中找到提示。本作最贴心的功能是照片功能，按方向键上可以调出相机，将暂时无法解开的谜题或无法通过的道路拍照钉在地图上，方便之后查缺补漏。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-69488Gc.jpg
战斗部分，除了少数使用弹夹的枪可以一次上弹以外，单发上弹的诸如左轮、步枪、霰弹枪等则需要进行 QTE 交互，在指针到达指定区域时按下才可以顺利上弹，机制类似《战争机器》（Gears of War），这在焦灼的战斗中着实有些拖沓。相比而言，投掷道具可以说是真正的大杀器，在面对群体敌人时十分有效。
除了上文提到的隐藏结局外，玩家还可以触发其它两个结局，其中之一是一周目默认的普通结局。而在通关后选择“继续游戏”，雷德选择不对峙最终 Boss 就可以回到银松镇，在路上可以捡到能够解锁最佳结局的必要道具。然而即便结算画面的探索度达到 100%，也不代表屏幕前的你完全知晓了这座时间已经定格的小镇的所有秘密。
作为 WEG 的第一款作品，又是业界少见的生存恐怖类银河城游戏，《银松镇》或许可以算是独立恐怖游戏领域今年最大的惊喜之一。从绵绵细雨到狂风暴雨的灰暗场景、低吼的行尸走肉与探索乐趣极高的地图共同给热爱这两个类型的玩家带来了一段 15 至 20 小时的优秀生存恐怖之旅。
2D 游戏的空间感缺失则让即时战斗乐趣稍打折扣，举起武器后无法移动的设定让雷德在面对行动迅速或者有地形高低差的敌人时稍显笨拙。除了一把带有激光瞄准器的手枪以外，枪械的瞄准精度也是个大问题。此外，游戏提供了四种难度，但在较高难度下，逐渐积攒起强力枪械和各类生存资源的玩家可能会产生“前期难度过高，后期难度过低”的割裂感。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/10/pic-79539Xx.jpg
大卫·林奇风的晦涩剧情则只能说是见仁见智，即便搜集了所有文档，阅读了所有对话，玩家对银松镇的秘密以及雷德的身世之谜的了解可能也只是浮于表面。只有经过深度思考和脉络梳理，或是在另一个维度换位思考，才可能揭开银松镇神秘的面纱。

items.title: 科技创始人批评旧金山最贫困社区射击“僵尸”的氛围编码游戏
items.summary: City residents and leaders denounced the free web game, which was taken down.

content.v: Pierre-Louis Biojout, founder of Y Combinator-backed AI startup NanoCorp, took heat from San Francisco residents and city leaders this week after publishing a weekend vibe coding project: a web-based shooter set in SF's Tenderloin district, which is known for homelessness and open drug use.

"San Francisco couldn't fix the Tenderloin," Biojout said in a now-deleted X post on October 13. "So I monetized it [as a] Call of Duty style zombie shooter on the real SF streets." He noted that he'd already made $300 from in-game ads.
The game, called Tenderloin Night Shift, had players shoot "zombies" that, according to reports from the SF Chronicle and KRON4 news , included a "folded" fentanyl addict and a Black security guard.

Speaking to the Chronicle, Jennifer Friedenbach, executive director of the SF Coalition on Homelessness, said that Biojout was "monetizing the dehumanization and pretend killing for fun of mostly Black and Brown residents of the poorest neighborhood in San Francisco."
In a correspondence with the paper, Biojout said that he had not intended to "provoke or to depict shooting real people" and that the game also included tech workers as characters.
Tenderloin Night Shift appears to have been removed from NanoCorp's website. Although Biojout deleted his X post, the discourse that ensued remains.
"You made a game about shooting people in active addiction," said another tech founder. "These are human beings, not zombies. show me the positive side of this - i'm probably blind."
"Why are you talking about addiction? It's a zombie shooter," Biojout said in response.

Some commenters, however, expressed approval for the message Biojout has disavowed. "They are currently NOT human beings," said one user , while another said they'd "train in bro's game" to prepare to visit San Francisco.

others.title: CD Projekt 确认真人版《赛博朋克 2077》电影不会追随游戏的脚步

content.v: We learned last week that a Cyberpunk 2077 movie is in the works , an announcement I used mainly to talk about a completely different cyberpunk movie starring Keanu Reeves as a guy named Johnny who's having a bad week. Now we've got a bit more insight into what CD Projekt Red has in mind for the film, and it's possible that a guy named Johnny may not be involved at all.

"Our contract with Anonymous Content expired, and in the meantime, an opportunity arose to establish cooperation with Paramount Pictures," co-CEO Michał Nowakowski told Polish PAP Biznes ( Google translated ), referring to the Cyberpunk 2077 "live action project" that was announced in 2023 and ultimately went nowhere. "We decided that we would conduct a live-action Cyberpunk project in a new formula.

"At this point, we can only say that we definitely don't want to make a film adaptation of the game. We want to tell a story in the world of Cyberpunk, but it won't be a one-to-one translation of the game's story."

I loved Cyberpunk 2077, and the fact that it featured two Hollywood stars in central roles might make it seem like a natural fit for a direct translation. But I think avoiding that approach is the wiser move: V's story has been told, and trying to replicate it on film only invites unflattering comparisons and criticism. And it's not as though the world of Night City is short of other stories to tell, after all, nor would it be difficult to indirectly tie it to the game through references or cameos, if the urge to do so is really that strong.

Remember as well that two of the most successful game-to-screen adaptations, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners and Resident Evil , took their respective underlying settings and made them their own. That's basically what Cyberpunk 2077 is, as far as that goes: A vision of Mike Pondsmith's Cyberpunk tabletop setting, interpreted through the lens of a new timeline. They're all stronger for it, because they allow creators to work within a particular framework without tying them to specifics.
It's way too early in the process to say when all of this big-screen fun will actually happen, but Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 is set to debut on Netflix on October 20.

items.summary: The developers behind Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse are enthusiastic about the “horny” fanart they’ve seen of t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/castlevania-belmonts-curse-devs-made-the-characters-hot-on-purpose-1792184534105.jpg
The developers behind Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse are enthusiastic about all the “horny” fanart they’ve seen of the game’s characters, saying they specifically made them "hot" to appeal to fans.
Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse released on October 15, and you’ve no doubt already seen the wealth of wild reactions to the title from players online — particularly in regards to its character designs.

Yes, it’s true; players are thirsty for Trevor Belmont and the various monsters they must fight as they navigate the chaotic streets of Paris, but they shouldn’t feel embarrassed about it. In fact, the devs were counting on this to happen.

Speaking with Fall Damage , marketing director and lead designer Bérenger Dupré and Sandro Bordier revealed that they are absolutely loving the thirsty reactions to the game’s characters — and that includes the “horny” fanart that they’ve seen on social media.
“Oh, it has started already. Like, man, have we seen some things,” Bordier joked.
“Trevor, especially,” Dupré added. “Didn’t realize that he would be so well-received.”
“Do you think we could add a ‘Hot Dads Edition?’” Bourdier asked, prompting Dupré to say that there “should be a Game Award for hot dads.”

“It’s always fun to see the fanart, because we know how important and dear these characters are to the fans. We are trying to make some new, fresh stories with them, so it’s always quite stressful. And for now, the reception is very, very emotional,” Dupré continued.

The duo went on to admit that they went out of their way to make these characters attractive, with Boudier saying, “Yes, like we know some characters are hot. It’s a choice, actually. Like it’s a vibe. We’re pretty proud of it.”

“Honestly, we were super happy with all the fan reactions regarding the characters that were revealed,” he added. “We really put a lot of love from the team to design them in a way that would please fans. We were super happy to see how they reacted to the designs and the voice actor reveals, of course.”

Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse released to solid reviews, with IGN’s Scott White scoring the game an eight out of ten , praising it for “bringing Konami’s beloved series into the modern era with a fast-paced focus on action first.”

It’s clear that a lot of love went into this title; among the various Easter Eggs and secret codes found within, the devs also paid homage to classic fighting game characters , which can be seen if players nab a hidden weapon in one of the game’s first areas.

items.title: 我们认为《GTA 6》将打破所有记录
items.summary: After years of development and perhaps more hype than for any game, GTA 6 is set for release on November 19 fo

content.v: After years of development and perhaps more hype than for any game, GTA 6 is set for release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Predicting that it will be an enormous success commercially is perhaps one of the safest bets anyone could make.
But just how big will the launch be? And what records could GTA 6 beat if it delivers?
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_01_9c1af5.jpg?w=636
The records

The last GTA game, 2013's GTA 5, was a huge hit right out of the gate. It brought in $800 million in revenue over its first 24 hours and $1 billion in its first three days . Even a decade later, the game remains a sales juggernaut, eclipsing 230 million copies sold and counting .

Rockstar's latest game, 2018's Red Dead Redemption II, launched with $725 million in revenue over its opening weekend . It's gone on to sell more than 87 million copies, making it one of the top five best-selling games ever .
Outside of Rockstar, Bethesda's 2015 RPG Fallout 4 had a gigantic launch, shipping 12 million copies for launch day alone , generating sales in excess of $750 million.
So to sum up, here are the records that GTA 6 is expected to surpass:

GTA 6 has enormous shoes to fill to match and surpass Rockstar's previous games and Fallout 4. But if Sensor Tower's data that projects 25 million preorders by launch is correct--or even close--then it should have no problem beating GTA 5's initial sales.

One thing working in GTA 6's favor when it comes to comparisons to past games is that GTA 6 has a higher selling price. The base game goes for $80, compared to the $60 that GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption II launched at years ago.

Of course, $60 in 2013 dollars equates to about $85 today when factoring in inflation. But even inflation-adjusted figures would likely show that GTA 6 has a bigger launch, if it becomes the hit everyone expects it to. And when Take-Two inevitably shares GTA 6 sales data, you can bet the company will present the data is the absolute best possible light, whatever language and specifics it takes to get there.
The numbers so far

Officially, neither Rockstar nor parent company Take-Two have shared any numbers at all about preorders or sales projections since preorders opened in June. Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick said it would not be prudent to disclose preorder figures because they could be misleading. His argument was that, technically speaking, GTA 6 has not sold a single copy yet, as, in theory, every preordered copy of the game could be returned. That's silly, of course; it sounds more like Zelnick is staying true to his mantra of never declaring success before it occurs.
Whatever the case, Zelnick said GTA 6 preorders "vastly" surpassed international expectations, but he did not say what those expectations were or "whether they mean anything" anyway.
Zelnick said sharing real, raw data for GTA 6 preorders could mislead investors, so Take-Two is not going to do so.

“I’ve reminded people that we simply don’t know the demand curve because it’s just never happened before,” Zelnick said. “Given that, we think the raw numbers could potentially be misleading in a direction we wouldn’t feel good about.”

Speaking during Take-Two’s latest earnings call, Zelnick said of GTA 6’s preorder numbers, “No one’s ever seen anything like this before at Take-Two, or in the industry.” He added: “To be clear, we haven’t sold one unit yet. You can cancel a preorder.”
$2 billion by launch?

The research firm Sensor Tower has a "GTA 6 Sales Tracker" site that shows estimates for GTA 6 preorders, displaying 6.08 million through October 13, and that apparently includes any returned/refunded copies. The group estimates that this works out to $594 million in revenue so far, with a split of 74% for PlayStation 5 and 26% for Xbox Series X|S.
Sensor Tower's Karl Kontus said in an interview that reorders for GTA 6 could be in the area of 25 million when the game releases, which would amount to “unprecedented preorder performance.”

At 25 million, that would work out to about $2 billion in revenue, which would cover the game's development budget and the majority of the marketing spend, he said. Kontus went on to say that he expects the majority of GTA 6 preorders to come in the last week or so before launch, as the hype peaks. Currently, the preorder split is skewing toward the $100 edition, Sensor Tower said, but that makes sense since people who preorder early are probably more on the enthusiast side. At launch, Sensor Tower said it expects about a 50/50 split between the $80 and $100 editions for preorder numbers.
Launch is only the beginning

GTA 6 is being marketed as a single-player experience that will be available on console exclusively. That may be true for now, but everyone expects Rockstar to release the next evolution of GTA Online for GTA 6 , and eventually bring the game to PC. A recent report said the PC edition could launch sooner than expected.

The investment company Jeffries released a note recently that says Take-Two's stock is currently trading at a discount at about $200/share today, October 16, and could jump to $300/share. The company is bullish on Take-Two not just because GTA 6 is expected to be a huge hit, but also because the next version of GTA Online will represent another revenue vector, and the expected PC edition will create another selling cycle.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Cal_Hampton_02_219045.jpg?w=636

These are not wild predictions. After all, GTA Online, to this day, continues to bring in steady revenue for Take-Two through its various microtransactions and the GTA+ subscription service. It's only reasonable to assume Rockstar would further flesh out GTA Online for GTA 6 and create even more ways for people to spend time (and money) in the world. As for the PC edition, it makes a lot of sense that it would drive people to pick up the game there if that's their preferred platform, and they could be double-dippers, further enriching Take-Two in the process.
A different console market

GTA 5 launched at the very tail end of the PS3 and Xbox 360 console lifecycles, which created a unique situation that no doubt increased the game's sales potential. Those consoles combined for an install base of more than 150 million units, so Rockstar had an enormous market to sell into. And as stated above, it sold fantastically in this environment.

Rockstar launched the game for those platforms, but then also brought it to PS4 and Xbox One, and then to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S in the years that followed, with new improvements along the way. People didn't need to pay again, as free upgrades were offered in some situations, but it can be safely assumed many people double-dipped.

GTA 6 is launching in a very different world for the console market, as the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S are today more expensive than ever due to tariffs, the AI-fueled demand for memory and components, the war in Iran, and various other global macroeconomic factors driving up prices. The PS5 has sold more than 95 million units, and it's estimated that Xbox Series X|S is about a third of that, so there are probably more than 120 million combined units out there.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/09/25/scwk6j-1758769803399.jpg
Ghost of Yōtei sales appear to be trailing behind Ghost of Tsushima , but that doesn't mean it's not still pulling big numbers on PlayStation 5.

That's according to Alinea Analytics head of marketing analysis Rhys Elliott, who shared data related to Sucker Punch Productions' 2025 sequel on X/Twitter . Although this is sales information that has yet to be confirmed by Sony, it may still give us a peek behind the curtain at how Ghost of Yōtei has fared on PS5.

The result: Sucker Punch's action follow-up has done well in its first year, even if it hasn't quite managed to pass up its predecessor. Alinea's analysis puts Ghost of Yōtei sales at about 5.4 million units, generating $407 million in revenue so far. Highlights from that update put the physical slice at a notable 36.8%, while PlayStation Store discounts remain largely few and far between.

Around 500,000 copies were sold in Q3 2026 alone. Alinea also reported that 50,000 players have picked up the digital Complete Edition – which comes with new content, including the recently released Echoes of Sekigahara expansion – in the two weeks since PlayStation launched it as a replacement for the digital base game. With the analysis estimating that around 6% of its existing base returned to play the new content, it seems Ghost of Yōtei is going strong – but there is more to the story.

Ghost of Tsushima, which launched in a market still coming to grips with pandemic lockdowns in July 2020, had generated about $418 million by the same point in its lifespan, Elliott added in a follow-up post. Factoring in Yōtei's base price of $70 vs Tsushima's base price of $60, as well as any discounts that followed, the latter is estimated to have sold almost 7 million copies by this point.
That puts Tsushima moving at a much faster pace in terms of raw units sold, but there is more at play here, especially considering revenue is almost neck and neck.

How do Ghost of Yotei’s revenues compare to Tsushima’s? Our estimates (@alineaanalytics) show that Yotei has generated revenue of $407M. At this point, launch-aligned, Ghost of Tsushima had made $418M, so about 3% more. As Yotei costs $70, and has had just two discounts, and Tsushima was $60 at launch (and was already discounted to $45 less than three months post-launch), Tsushima had sold more copies at this point. Nearly 7M versus Yotei’s 5.4M. This is about 26% more revenue per buyer, which is consistent with PlayStation’s goal of extracting more revenue per player. While that’s quite the gap in terms of copies, it’s worth noting that by this point in Tsushima’s lifecycle, there were about 117M PS4s and 10M PS5s in the wild, versus the nearly 100M PS5s currently out there right now (Yotei’s only platform). That said, Yotei’s revenue is beginning to flatten more than Tsushima’s did, but perhaps the GTA-driven influx of new PS5s will soften that. Yotei has proven to be an evergreen seller in a crowded market, shifting 1.8M copies this year ($121M in revenue) despite having just two small discounts and competing with what is one of the busiest and highest-quality release calendars … ever. So yeah, anyone who says that Ghost of Yotei is a flop is flat-out wrong. (Note: the Y-axis starts at $392M. Otherwise, the chart wouldn’t be readable, as the numbers are so close)

"While that’s quite the gap in terms of copies, it’s worth noting that by this point in Tsushima’s lifecycle, there were about 117M PS4s and 10M PS5s in the wild, versus the nearly 100M PS5s currently out there right now (Yōtei's only platform)," Elliott explained. "That said, Yōtei's revenue is beginning to flatten more than Tsushima’s did, but perhaps the GTA-driven influx of new PS5s will soften that."

In other words, although Ghost of Tsushima had managed to move more copies by this point after its launch, Ghost of Yōtei is holding its own. Early estimates after the sequel's launch also had it falling in line with the original game , with Sony going on to confirm in February of this year that the follow-up "exceeded" Tsushima's sales and "significantly contributed" to its financial results for that quarter. As Elliott clarified today, "anyone who says that Ghost of Yōtei is a flop is flat-out wrong."

Ghost of Yōtei launched in October 2025 and is exclusive to PS5. IGN gave it an 8/10 review , saying, "A predictable but well-executed story takes you through Ghost of Yotei's gorgeous landscapes and satisfying, fluid action – it may not be revolutionizing open world games, but it's a great distillation of the samurai fantasy." It recently added a new armor set based on PlayStation's The Last of Us .

content.v: One day into Wardogs Season 2, Bulkhead Interactive has decided to scrap the bribery plan it announced last week as a way to help convince players to join the Blue team. The problem isn't that the plan didn't work—it actually worked far too well.
THE PLAN:
THE REALITY:

"We're removing the Blue XP bonus, the cash bonus. We were wrong," Brammer said. Bulkhead co-founder Howard Philpott added that the studio thought Blue team bonus might work out this way, but said "I don't think we expected it to be this much of a swing."

I can't say I'm terribly surprised by the outcome. I'm not a Wardogs player, but I have been around long enough to know how these things go: If you dangle a competitive edge in front of gamers, they're going to jump for it. Percentage boosts are especially risky because they're performance-based and so much more likely to go spinning out of control, especially in the hands of, as Brammer put it, "tryhards."

And it's not just the extra XP and cash being earned that's a problem: Philpott said the bonus is also "impacting people joining games and starting games," presumably because if they can't be a Blue, they'll leave and try their luck with another game.

(Quick side note: I'm not a fan of the term 'tryhard.' Of course I'm trying hard! Why wouldn't I be? My nephew called me a tryhard once and I told him that maybe if he tried harder he wouldn't get his ass kicked so hard. He was 12 and I got some disapproving looks from other people at the Christmas party, but I stand by it.)

We're holding our hands up and we got a few things wrong.We are pushing a backend update: ▫️Removing Blue Cash & XP Bonus▫️Driver Progression Fixes▫️Fixing Driver Exploit Preventing lots of players from accessing tanks too early▫️Coming Soon: Limited Mode Servers (No Power Weapons & Vehicles)Full details in the video here: October 15, 2026

PC Gamer's Morgan Park, who is a Wardogs guy, also made the call when this plan was unveiled last week: "XP and cash bribes are a drastic move, but should have a real impact. It's unclear how big these boosts will be, but I expect Blue will instantly become the most popular team by a wide margin in Season 2."

Predictable as this outcome was, I don't see it as a particularly egregious misstep. Brammer called it an "experiment," and sometimes that's what you have to do—and the early stages of a massively popular videogame with teething issues can definitely be one of those times. Brammer also noted that other changes aimed at rebalancing things, including new spawns on the Bakurani map, have proven effective and will remain.

Alongside the removal of the Blue team bribery, Bulkhead is also fixing issues with driver progression, and is fixing a driver exploit that's letting players access tanks too quickly: Players who are "very clearly" taking advantage of the exploit (less than 1,000 in total, according to Brammer) will be given a 24-hour ban from the game and have their cash and XP wiped.

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever's beta will be free for a limited time next week, giving players who want to check out the new version of Blizzard's old-school MMORPG but don't want to pay $60 for beta access a chance to see what all the hype is about.

Blizzard announced a WoW: Forever stress test will begin October 19 at 2 PM PT/ 5 PM ET, with no WoW subscription or beta access needed to play. The goal is to put the game's servers through their paces ahead of launch.
"This is a highly valuable event, since you'll participate in our discovering of issues that would have otherwise happened on launch day," Blizzard said in a post announcing the stress test.

To install the test, players will need the Battle.net launcher installed and an account. After selecting WoW: Forever from the list of games, players can select to install the stress test under the "Game Version" drop-down menu.

There is, however, a catch. The stress test will only run for a "few hours," according to Blizzard. Exactly how long the test will last is still unclear. Blizzard said the test window "may end earlier or run later as needed." During the time that the stress test is live, the game's closed beta will be offline, but will return following the conclusion of the test. All characters made during the stress test will be deleted once the test is over.

It's not much, but for those who wanted to at least dabble in WoW: Forever without having to buy the $60 Skyborne Epic Pack for a beta code, the stress test will at least let curious players dip their toes in.

Even the beta itself won't be around for much longer. It will run until October 21, after which it will shut down and characters will be deleted to make way for early name reservations for the full game on October 27. WoW: Forever launches the following week on November 4.

All indicators so far point towards WoW: Forever's beta being a massive success . Multiple Blizzard developers have commented on how the game's popularity has already broken records, signaling launch could be huge.

The beta hasn't been all sunshine and rainbows, however. Multiple controversies have riled up the WoW community over the course of the beta, revealing WoW: Forever has a streamer problem . Illicit gold-buying scandals in the beta have pushed Blizzard to crack down on the practice harder than ever before (going so far as to add new in-game restrictions and warnings). Meanwhile, one controversial streamer is looking to create the biggest WoW guild ever seen and dominate the game's sole PvP server, much to the annoyance of regular players.
In a recent interview with GameSpot, Blizzard shared more details about WoW: Forever's future , and how it's trying to "push the envelope" on what players expect.

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever's beta is set to end in just a few days on October 21, but that hasn't stopped Blizzard from making some major changes to the game's various racial abilities.

Unlike in the modern version of WoW, where racial abilities are so minor that they mostly feel cosmetic, racial abilities in WoW Classic (and now in Forever) are a big part of why players choose to play a particular race. Some races synergise better with certain classes or playstyles. Others even benefit more from using specific types of weapons.

Or at least they used to. In Forever's latest beta update, developer Blizzard has overhauled many of the MMO's racial abilities to remove weapon-specific buffs and improve some abilities that were seen as lackluster by the community.

The removal of weapon-based passives for humans, dwarves, and orcs is a significant change. Orcs used to favor axes, humans swords and maces, and dwarves guns. In WoW Classic, that meant an increased weapon skill when using those weapons, resulting in a better chance to hit and increased damage.

That changed for WoW: Forever's beta. Blizzard kept some of the weapon-specific flavor, but instead of weapon skill, pivoted to critical-strike chance. Now with this latest update, those bonuses no longer require players of a certain race to wield a specific weapon type to gain those passive benefits. Orcs simply gain a 1% increase to crit chance, humans gain a 2% increase to crit chance, and dwarves deal 2% increased critical damage and healing at all times.

It's a major departure, but feels like it will ultimately allow for more freedom when it comes to using a variety of weapons. Those weren't the only racial ability changes though. Blizzard also updated tauren's new Plainsrunning ability and dwarves' Find Treasure.

Both of these left something to be desired. Plainsrunning, which granted a stacking movement speed buff for tauren while on foot, was useful early on while leveling but felt like it would largely become irrelevant once players earned their first mount. For dwarves, being able to locate chests using their Find Treasure passive was nice, but hardly a reason to choose them over another race like humans, which generally have stronger racial abilities overall.

Blizzard has improved Plainsrunning to also grant a 3% mounted movement speed buff that can stack with other mount buffs, making the passive useful post-level 40. Tauren additionally received a decreased cooldown for their herb-gathering Cultivation skill and their area-of-effect stun, War Stomp. As for dwarves, Find Treasure now grants a chance to find additional items in chests, which is certainly appealing given how important gold is in this version of Blizzard's MMO.

Skyborne racial abilities, the newest playable race added in WoW: Forever, have also received some welcome improvements, with an increased Haste bonus (to 3% from 1%), and the ability to cast Skysight and Read Leyline while moving. More leylines, which Skyborne use for some of their racial abilities, have been added to Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, giving Skyborne more chances to renew their buffs.

Undead, gnomes, trolls, and night elves have seen changes, too. For undead, their Forever-exclusive Touch of the Grave passive has been adjusted to have a more consistent proc chance and cooldown. Gnomes' Eureka passive now is an eight-second buff with no charges. Changes to night elves and trolls are relatively minor. Trolls received an increase to health regeneration from their Regeneration passive. Meanwhile, the night elf movement speed passive Quickness now stacks with other movement speed buffs.

Not all the racial ability changes have been buffs. A few were nerfs, particularly for orcs. Their Blood Fury racial, which grants increased attack and spell power, has had its cooldown increased by an entire minute, and their Shatter Curse passive has made it so it now dispels Curses and Banes rather than granting full immunity. The amount of magic damage reduction from Shatter Curse was also lowered from a massive 15% to just 5%.

All together, they represent some of the biggest racial ability changes in the game's history, and could be a big factor in deciding what race to play when WoW: Forever launches November 4. You can read the full patch notes below, which include some signficant class changes as well.

In an interview with GameSpot, Blizzard revealed how it's trying to "push the envelope" with the amount of new content in Forever as well as discussed its plans for endgame and what to expect post launch.

items.title: Switch 2 上的《现代战争 4》并不是你想象的灾难
items.summary: Modern Warfare 4 is the first Call of Duty since 2013 to launch on a Nintendo console. We played the campaign

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/mw4-switch-blog-1792059802695.jpg

Not since 2013’s Call of Duty: Ghosts launched on the Wii U has a mainline COD game appeared on a Nintendo console. 2026’s Modern Warfare 4 is breaking that 14-year dry spell by releasing on Switch 2, and I got to play a couple of missions from the campaign to see how it fares. I won’t lie, my expectations were low – Call of Duty is always on the cutting edge of graphics and performance, and Nintendo’s latest isn’t intentionally built for that. And yet, I came away pleasantly surprised by what Digital Legends, the Activision studio dedicated to this version of MW4, has achieved from a technical standpoint.

For my full review of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , I played on PC, which provided a useful benchmark for what the most ideal version of the game looks like. Of course, when placed side-by-side with the Switch 2 version, you’ll immediately notice the difference — it looks stunning on PC and runs like a dream, as you’d expect. But, shifting over to Switch 2 didn’t offend my eyes quite like I feared it would. Granted, the textures are nowhere near as detailed, with flat surfaces and faces smoothed over to give the impression of plasticine versions of the campaign’s characters. It's by no means a looker, but considering the reduced horsepower Nintendo’s latest console is working with, the gameplay itself was smooth, running at 30fps at 4K while docked. The campaign is locked at 30, while multiplayer will target 60.

That campaign framerate remained consistent, too, not even hitching or stuttering during some of the story’s most explosive moments — I deliberately made sure to capture part of a mission that showcases one of its most hectic sequences to test it out. You can check that gameplay out for yourself in the video above, but I was left impressed that a game which normally demands so much of the hardware it is being played on performed so well on the Switch 2. Yes, it's quite a visual downgrade when compared to the likes of PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X, but that comes with the territory. And if you’re solely a Nintendo owner who’s been locked out of Call of Duty for over a decade, you’re getting a version of Modern Warfare 4 that feels every bit as snappy as the series usually is, even if it’s a bit muddier than Nintendo’s own crisp visuals.

items.summary: Hellraiser: Revival understands Clive Barker on a much deeper level than just gore and sex — it's a deeply aut

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/17/hr1-oo-1789670071470.png
Warning: This article contains spoilers for Hellraiser: Revival.

The first five minutes of Hellraiser: Revival will make your eyebrows high-five the ceiling. It opens with a BDSM-flavored sex scene complete with piercing and blood and a veritable buffet of sex toys scattered around the room, then evolves into a gory example of what hooks and chains can do to flesh. If you're sweet and innocent you might want to clutch some pearls, but to Clive Barker fans like me it's a signal that Revival is committing to the spirit of the author and director’s sexy subversion rather than watering it down. And I'm not an easy woman to please. The original Hellraiser movie rewired my brain when I saw it as a teenager (yes, I have a therapist), and Barker's Books of Blood volumes are in my top five reads of all time. I was bracing for disappointment, but that opening proved that Revival wasn't going to shy away from the body horror or sex that runs through Barker's work. The Hellraiser world is one of horrible and hedonistic extremes, so trying to avoid either would be like trying to swap Beyond Meat patties for prime rib. And the deeper I got into Hellraiser: Revival, the clearer it became that the game's understanding of those extremes went beyond pure sex and gore.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/07/hellraiser-ending-blog-1791378852136.jpg

Expanding on any existing fiction, especially one as iconic as the Hellraiser series, is a challenge for anyone. Luckily, developer Saber Interactive was able to work with its creator directly, with Nenad Tomic, Revival’s executive producer, telling Xbox Wire that Barker was "deeply involved with the game from the very beginning" and shaped everything from "visual style and story motifs to the lore and character personalities." From a player experience perspective, it's key that the game stars the OG Pinhead, Doug Bradley, because no one wants a bad impersonator ruining the party.

Some parallels are obvious. Saber Interactive has explicitly said that Revival’s protagonist, Aidan, was inspired by Julia from Barker’s novella The Hellbound Heart and its film adaptation, Hellraiser, and you can see the game playing with the same themes of obsessive attachment, sexual need, and total simp behavior. Julia is willing to act as a honey trap to secure victims for her oozing lover, while Aidan is ready to make a deal with Pinhead and then go on a killing spree to bring back his girl. It's at once beautiful and twisted, and if nothing else a step up from a man who rolls his eyes when you ask him to share his fries. Never settle, ladies.

"Like Julia, Aidan is a character experiencing a fundamental dissatisfaction with life,” Antony De Fault, Hellraiser: Revival’s narrative director, tells me. “His heart yearns for feelings of purpose and vitality, and like Julia, the object of that fixation is a person with an even deeper dissatisfaction, who accelerates his self-destructive tendencies. In Aidan’s case, that’s his girlfriend Sunny.

"The most significant difference between the two is that Julia has suppressed her yearning for a long time, attempting to play the ‘good housewife,' whereas Aidan has pursued it,” De Fault continues. “This history of troublemaking and criminality makes him more worldly, and in particular, more equipped for violence.

"This was a deliberate departure from Julia’s mold, since Aidan is a player character in an FPS horror game. We wanted to give the player a variety of gameplay experiences, which included stealth, exploration, and enemies you can’t directly fight (the experiences of Kirsty in the movies), but also ‘game-y’ experiences like combat challenges and resource management. For those, a more competent character like Aidan made sense."

Throughout Hellraiser: Revival’s story, we get to see flashbacks of Sunny and Aidan’s relationship and better understand how a devotion strong enough to send you into the Labyrinth, the Cenobites’ hellish dimension ruled by Leviathan, develops. The ties that bind you need to be stronger than meeting at a work Christmas party and sharing a love of Netflix reality shows for that sort of errand. Aidan was a drug addict, now Sunny is his fix – she changed his life and he's not sure what trying to go on without her would even look like. We also get a little glimpse at what happens when only one half of a couple is on board with worshipping at the altar of pleasure and pain thanks to a couple called Sean and Charlotte, whose story we learn through letters scattered around the world. Spoiler: It is not a happy ending.
Like a Prayer

As well as ensuring fans get to see all their favorites – Pinhead, Butterball, and my personal nightmare fuel, Chatterer – Hellraiser: Revival makes its own contribution to the lore by diving deeper into the idea of an organized religion, The Scarlet Church, developing around the Cenobites. The films have played with the idea before (check out Hellraiser: Deader), but Revival goes all in on a doctrine, some seriously intense interior decor choices, and a brutal path to ascension. In its teachings, pain is a gift that can be given and received, and even a kindness, though it's not beyond exploiting people when it comes to recruiting new members.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/img-3842-1792166456215.JPG

"In a practical sense, we knew that the player couldn’t fight the Cenobites, and that simply running away from them wasn’t going to support an entire game,” explains De Fault. “So we had good cause to invent some sort of force that would often oppose the player in their stead, while still evoking the Cenobites and feeling like it belonged in the world of Hellraiser.
"From there, the leap to a Cenobite-inspired cult seems pretty logical, especially given the religious themes present in Clive’s work," he says.

The church's congregation is the mutilated faithful, whose hobbies include sticking knives in people and wearing latex. De Fault explains that, like the parallels between Aidan and Julia, the church in some ways represents Frank from the original Hellraiser.
"They’re people who are so dissatisfied with life, so numb to it, that they will go to incredible extremes in their pursuit of intense experiences that make them feel vital,” he says.

"But like Frank, as you’ll discover in the game, the Scarlet Church aren’t actually prepared for the reality of what the Cenobites offer. They seek the Cenobites because they want hedonic pleasure, or power, as opposed to what the Cenobites really are, which is more spiritual (“Explorers, in the further regions of experience”). The only one who really ‘gets it’ is their misunderstood Prophet, Bruno."

Another key player in the cult is an unhinged doctor called Colin Marlowe, who shares an approach to elective surgery that would make even Beverly Hills trophy wives think, "Now steady on." And then there's Charlotte, who gives an insight into why someone might follow the teachings of the church, writing things like, "There is divinity in my wretchedness, splendor in every ugly part of me," and "For the first time in my life, I feel accepted and understood. I can be myself... my true self... the Scarlet Church gave me that truth.” For her, submitting to the church represents acceptance, identity, and a way to see the parts of herself she despises as sacred rather than shameful.

content.v: The phrase 'RMA' is likely to send shivers down many a spine, especially when it concerns something like a graphics card. Returning a faulty component can often be a 'cross your fingers and hope for the best' kind of deal, so naturally I am pleasantly— very pleasantly—surprised to hear Asus has enough of a heart to not only give one lucky Redditor an upgrade but also get the colour right.

According to the Redditor's original post about the issue, they sent their white Asus ROG Strix RTX 4080 Super OC in for RMA and were sent back a black Asus TUF Gaming RTX 5080 when they discovered the former couldn't be repaired. That's a win, right? Well, not fully , because the Redditor wanted a white one, like their original RTX 4080 Super, to match their all-white build.

So, what's to be done about that? Naturally, asking for them to swap it : "After about 6 weeks of emails and escalating the case to higher-level management, Asus finally approved the exact card I asked for: the ROG Astral RTX 5080 White OC. I sent the TUF back, and they even upgraded the shipping to FedEx Standard Overnight at no extra cost. The card finally arrived!"

This is an RMA result, if ever I've seen one. It might seem a bit much, but to be honest if you have an all-white build and an expensive GPU that fails, I can see why it makes sense to at least attempt to get a replacement just right.

Funnily enough, I can speak to this very kind of issue with a much cheaper product. A few years ago, I sent my cream-coloured Sennheiser HD 599 headphones for RMA, and they sent back a new pair... except they were black, not the lovely cream colour I sent off. But being the non-confrontational and lazy weasel I am, I just accepted my fate, and those are the headphones I use to this day.
